cues.zh: 大家好，我是 Brian Carris，Epic Games 的工程研究员。
cues.en: Hello, I'm Brian Carris, engineering fellow at Epic Games.

cues.zh: 今天，我将带大家深入了解 Nanite——UE5 全新的虚拟几何体系统。
cues.en: Today, I'm going to take you on a deep dive into Nanite, UE5's new virtual geometry system.

cues.zh: Nanite 建立在前人大量工作之上，可惜我没时间在这里逐一提及。
cues.en: Nanite builds on a ton of prior work that I unfortunately don't have time to touch on all individually here.

cues.zh: 请下载幻灯片，里面有完整的参考文献列表、综述与讨论，以及额外材料。
cues.en: Please download the slide deck for a full list of references, review and discussion, as well as bonus material.

cues.zh: 回想这些年来我参与过的工作，影响最大的那些，都从根本上改变了美术的创作方式。
cues.en: Thinking back on the things I've worked on over the years, the ones that had the largest impact were those that fundamentally changed how art was made.

cues.zh: 很多年前，我曾亲眼看到虚拟纹理系统能给美术团队带来怎样的影响。
cues.en: Many years ago, I got to see the impact that a virtual texturing system could have on an art team.

cues.zh: 美术师可以随心所欲地使用超大纹理，而不用操心内存预算，那是多么自由。
cues.en: How freeing it was for the artists to use giant textures wherever they wanted and not have to worry about memory budgets.

cues.zh: 我一直梦想着有一天，我们也能在几何体上做到同样的事。
cues.en: Ever since I dreamt of the day that we could do the same for geometry.

cues.zh: 它的影响甚至可能更大。
cues.en: The impact could be even greater.

cues.zh: 不再有几何体预算，就意味着不再需要担心多边形数量、绘制调用或内存。
cues.en: No more budgets for geometry would mean no more concern over poly counts, draw calls, or memory.

cues.zh: 没有这些限制，美术师就能直接使用电影级品质的资产，而不必花时间手动优化以便实时使用。
cues.en: Without those limitations, artists could use film quality assets without wasting any time manually optimizing them for use in real-time.

cues.zh: 为了达到帧率而优化美术内容，浪费的时间多得离谱。
cues.en: It's ridiculous how much time is wasted in optimizing art content to hit frame rate.

cues.zh: 这一切同样适用于场景布置。
cues.en: All this should hold true for set dressing as well.

cues.zh: 美术师应该能够随心所欲地放置任意数量的网格体。
cues.en: Artists should be able to place as many meshes as they want, however they want.

cues.zh: 如何最好地构建场景，应该由他们自己决定。
cues.en: It should be up to them how best to build a scene.

cues.zh: 当然，这一切都不能损失质量。
cues.en: And of course, all this with no loss in quality.

cues.zh: 如果画面不再像美术师最初创作的样子，那跑得再快又有什么意义？
cues.en: What's the point of running fast if it no longer looks like what the artist originally created?

cues.zh: 现实是，这比虚拟纹理难得多，因为它不只是内存管理问题。
cues.en: The reality is that this is a much harder task than virtual texturing because it's not just a memory management problem.

cues.zh: 几何细节会直接影响渲染开销，这一点和纹理不同。
cues.en: Geometry detail directly impacts rendering costs unlike textures.

cues.zh: 而且几何体也不像纹理那样容易过滤。
cues.en: And geometry isn't trivially filterable like textures either.

cues.zh: 那我们有哪些选择？
cues.en: So what are our options?

cues.zh: 体素和隐式曲面有很多潜在优势，也是解决这个问题讨论最多的方向。
cues.en: Voxels and implicit surfaces have a lot of potential advantages and are the most discussed direction to solve this problem.

cues.zh: 这是一个 200 万多边形的半身像，重采样成 1300 万窄带符号距离场体素。
cues.en: This is a two million poly bust, resampled the 13 million narrow band signed distance field voxels.

cues.zh: 我们已经考虑了稀疏性，不存储空体素或完全填充的体素。
cues.en: We've already accounted for sparsity and that no empty voxel or completely filled voxel is stored.

cues.zh: 然而，所需数据量仍达到六倍。
cues.en: And yet, six times the amount of data is needed.

cues.zh: 然而，它看起来还是团块感很重。
cues.en: And yet, it looks blobby.

cues.zh: 原因是体素化是一种均匀重采样，而均匀重采样意味着信息损失。
cues.en: The reason for this is voxelization is a form of uniform resampling and uniform resampling means loss.

cues.zh: 这相当于在3D中把矢量图形转换成像素图形。
cues.en: This is the 3D equivalent of converting vector graphics into pixel graphics.

cues.zh: 对于均匀采样的有机网格，比如这个例子中雕刻的皮肤，重采样可能不会造成太大破坏。
cues.en: For organic uniformly sampled meshes, like the sculpted skin in this example, resampling likely won't be that destructive.

cues.zh: 但另一方面，对于硬表面建模，它可能极具破坏性，如你所见。
cues.en: For hard surface modeling on the other hand, it can be extremely so, as you can see.

cues.zh: 本质上，体素的主要问题是数据量问题。
cues.en: In essence, the chief issue with voxels is a data size problem.

cues.zh: 需要最大程度地稀疏，才能保持数据量小。
cues.en: Maximum maximum sparsity is needed to keep data size small.

cues.zh: 但在这个过程中，我们不能牺牲光线投射性能。
cues.en: But we can't sacrifice ray casting performance in the process.

cues.zh: 数据结构需要高度自适应，才能获得锐利边缘，同时不在平滑区域浪费采样。
cues.en: And the data structure needs to be super adaptive to get sharp edges, but not waste samples where it's smooth.

cues.zh: 即使做到这些，存储的最精细分辨率仍不会是最初制作的分辨率。
cues.en: And even with all that, the finest resolution stored still won't be what was originally authored.

cues.zh: 无论如何，我们仍然是在重采样。
cues.en: No matter what, we are still resampling.

cues.zh: 是不是也得存下原始网格，靠近到一定程度就把它画出来？
cues.en: Do we have to store the original mesh, too, and draw that if you get close enough?

cues.zh: 还要注意，我们并不想彻底改变整个 CG 工作流。
cues.en: It's also important to note, we're not interested in completely changing all CG workflow.

cues.zh: 我们需要支持导入在任何地方制作的网格。
cues.en: We need to support importing of meshes authored anywhere.

cues.zh: 我们无法控制几何体是怎么制作的。
cues.en: We don't have control over how geometry is authored.

cues.zh: 这些网格会带有 UV 和平铺细节贴图。
cues.en: These meshes will have Uvs and tiling detail maps.

cues.zh: 虽然艺术家普遍讨厌 UV 映射，但它是程序化给表面加纹理的极强工具。
cues.en: Although UV mapping is universally hated by artists, it is an incredibly powerful tool for procedurally texturing surfaces.

cues.zh: 体素颜色不能作为可接受的替代方案，三平面投影也不行。
cues.en: Voxel colors are not an acceptable replacement nor is triplanar projection.

cues.zh: 我们只想替换网格，不替换纹理、不替换材质，也不替换与制作这些东西相关的所有工具。
cues.en: We are only looking to replace meshes, not textures, not materials, not all of the tools associated with authoring those things.

cues.zh: 那么，带 UV 的体素？
cues.en: With that in mind, voxels with Uvs?

cues.zh: 也许吧。
cues.en: Maybe.

cues.zh: 但 UV 接缝怎么办？
cues.en: But what to do about UV seams?

cues.zh: 更不用说还有无数其他问题，比如特征比一个体素还薄时，作为有符号距离场会直接消失。
cues.en: Not to mention countless other problems such as features which vanish as signed distance fields when they are thinner than a voxel.

cues.zh: 或者厚度不到几个体素时，属性会从一侧泄漏到另一侧；又或者到底该怎么给它们做动画。
cues.en: Or leak attributes from one side to the other when they are less than a few voxels or how the hell to animate them.

cues.zh: 这一切也许都能解决，但我的结论是，要完全取代显式表面，需要很多年不断累积的研究和行业经验。
cues.en: All this might be possible to solve, but my conclusion that it would need need many years of compounding research and industry experience to be able to replace explicit surfaces completely.

cues.zh: 我们还远没到那一步；即使到了，也不清楚它是否会更好。
cues.en: We aren't there yet and even if we were, it's unclear if it would be better.

cues.zh: 细分曲面怎么样？它们可以做到无限光滑，对吧？
cues.en: How about subdivision surfaces, they can get infinitely smooth, right?

cues.zh: 按定义，细分只是放大。
cues.en: Subdivision by definition is amplification only.

cues.zh: 近看效果很好，但复杂度不会低于基础控制笼。
cues.en: Great for up close, but doesn't get simpler than the base cage.

cues.zh: 我和我们的美术聊过，这个控制笼往往比典型游戏低模的面数还高。
cues.en: I spoke with our artists and the cage is very often higher than typical game low poly.

cues.zh: 在影视制作中，情况还要糟糕一个数量级。
cues.en: In film, it's an order of magnitude worse.

cues.zh: 我们需要让艺术家的创作选择与渲染成本脱钩。
cues.en: We need artist authoring choices disconnected from rendering cost.

cues.zh: 位移贴图怎么样？
cues.en: How about displacement maps?

cues.zh: 我们可以像现在做法线贴图那样，把位移也捕捉下来。
cues.en: We could capture displacement like we do normal maps now.

cues.zh: 使用矢量位移，低模还能更低，对吧？
cues.en: With vector displacement, the low poly could be even lower, right?

cues.zh: 某些情况下，当然可以。
cues.en: In some cases, sure.

cues.zh: 但像右图这种链条，低模该长什么样？
cues.en: But what's the low poly for a chain like the image in the right?

cues.zh: 你怎么把简单的东西位移成那样的链条？
cues.en: How would you displace something simple into that chain?

cues.zh: 其实做不到，因为位移无法增加曲面的亏格。
cues.en: You can't really because displacement can't increase the genus of a surface.

cues.zh: 说白了就是，你没法把一个球体位移成环面。
cues.en: That's a fancy way of saying you can't displace a sphere and turn it into a torus.

cues.zh: 还值得注意的是，投影到法线贴图或位移贴图是一种均匀重采样。
cues.en: It's also worth noting, projecting to normal or displacement maps is a form of uniform resampling.

cues.zh: 而均匀重采样意味着损失。
cues.en: And uniform resampling means loss.

cues.zh: 这相当于在 3D 中把矢量图形转换成像素图形。
cues.en: This is the 3D equivalent of converting vector graphics into pixel graphics.

cues.zh: 对于像这个示例中雕刻皮肤这样有机的均匀采样网格，重采样大概不会造成太大破坏。
cues.en: For organic uniformly sampled meshes, like the sculpted skin in this example, resampling likely won't be that destructive.

cues.zh: 但另一方面，对于硬表面建模，它可能造成极其严重的破坏，如你所见。
cues.en: For hard surface modeling on the other hand, it can be extremely so, as you can see.

cues.zh: 本质上，体素的主要问题是数据量问题。
cues.en: In essence, the chief issue with voxels is a data size problem.

cues.zh: 需要最大程度的稀疏性来保持数据量小，但不能在此过程中牺牲光线投射性能。
cues.en: Maximum maximum sparsity is needed to keep data size small, but we can't sacrifice ray casting performance in the process.

cues.zh: 并且数据结构必须高度自适应，以便获得锐利边缘，又不在平滑区域浪费采样。
cues.en: And the data structure needs to be super adaptive to get sharp edges but not waste samples where it's smooth.

cues.zh: 而且即便如此，存储的最高分辨率仍不会是最初制作时的分辨率。
cues.en: And even with all that, the finest resolution stored still won't be what was originally authored.

cues.zh: 无论如何，我们仍然是在重采样。
cues.en: No matter what, we are still resampling.

cues.zh: 我们是否必须连原始网格也存下来，并在你靠得足够近时绘制它？
cues.en: Do we have to store the original mesh too and draw that if you get close enough?

cues.zh: 同样重要的是，我们并不想彻底改变所有 CG 工作流。
cues.en: It's also important to note, we're not interested in completely changing all CG workflow.

cues.zh: 我们需要支持导入在任何地方制作好的网格。
cues.en: We need to support importing of meshes authored anywhere.

cues.zh: 我们无法控制几何体是如何制作的。
cues.en: We don't have control over how geometry is authored.

cues.zh: 这些网格会带有 UV 和平铺细节贴图。
cues.en: These meshes will have Uvs and tiling detail maps.

cues.zh: 尽管 UV 映射被美术们普遍讨厌，但它是程序化给表面做纹理的极其强大的工具。
cues.en: Although UV mapping is universally hated by artists, it is an incredibly powerful tool for procedurally texturing surfaces.

cues.zh: 体素颜色不是可接受的替代方案，三平面投影也不是。
cues.en: Voxel colors are not an acceptable replacement nor is triplanar projection.

cues.zh: 我们只想替换网格，而不是纹理、材质，也不是与制作这些东西相关的所有工具。
cues.en: We are only looking to replace meshes, not textures, not materials, not all of the tools associated with authoring those things.

cues.zh: 考虑到这一点，带 UV 的体素呢？
cues.en: With that in mind, voxels with Uvs?

cues.zh: 也许吧。
cues.en: Maybe.

cues.zh: 但 UV 接缝怎么办？
cues.en: But what to do about UV seams?

cues.zh: 更不用说还有许多其他问题，比如特征在作为有符号距离场时，一旦薄于一个体素就会消失。
cues.en: Not to mention countless other problems such as features which vanish as signed distance fields when they are thinner than a voxel.

cues.zh: 或者在它们间隔不到几个体素时，属性会从一侧泄漏到另一侧，还有到底该怎么给它们做动画。
cues.en: Or leak attributes from one side to the other when they are less than a few voxels or how the hell to animate them.

cues.zh: 这些或许都能解决，但我的结论是：要彻底取代显式曲面，需要多年不断积累的研究和行业经验。
cues.en: All this might be possible to solve, but my conclusion that it would need need many years of compounding research and industry experience to be able to replace explicit surfaces completely.

cues.zh: 我们还没到那一步；就算到了，也不清楚它会不会更好。
cues.en: We aren't there yet and even if we were, it's unclear if it would be better.

cues.zh: 细分曲面呢？
cues.en: How about subdivision surfaces?

cues.zh: 它们可以做到无限光滑，对吧？
cues.en: They can get infinitely smooth, right?

cues.zh: 按定义，细分只能做加密。
cues.en: Subdivision by definition is amplification only.

cues.zh: 近距离效果很好，但没法比基础控制笼更简单。
cues.en: Great for up close, but doesn't get simpler than the base cage.

cues.zh: 我和我们的美术聊过，控制笼的面数往往比典型游戏低模还高。
cues.en: I spoke with our artists and the cage is very often higher than typical game low poly.

cues.zh: 在电影里，还要糟糕一个数量级。
cues.en: In film, it's an order of magnitude worse.

cues.zh: 我们需要让美术的创作选择与渲染开销脱钩。
cues.en: We need artist authoring choices disconnected from rendering cost.

cues.zh: 那置换贴图呢？
cues.en: How about displacement maps?

cues.zh: 我们可以像现在做法线贴图那样捕获置换信息。
cues.en: We could capture displacement like we do normal maps now.

cues.zh: 用矢量置换的话，低模还能更低，对吧？
cues.en: With vector displacement, the low poly could be even lower, right?

cues.zh: 某些情况下，当然可以。
cues.en: In some cases, sure.

cues.zh: 但像右图那样的链条，它的低模该是什么样？
cues.en: But what's the low poly for a chain like the image in the right?

cues.zh: 你怎么把一个简单形状置换出那样的链条？
cues.en: How would you displace something simple into that chain?

cues.zh: 其实做不到，因为置换不能增加曲面的亏格。
cues.en: You can't really because displacement can't increase the genus of a surface.

cues.zh: 说白了就是，你不能把一个球体置换成一个环面。
cues.en: That's a fancy way of saying you can't displace a sphere and turn it into a torus.

cues.zh: 另外值得注意的是，投影到法线贴图或置换贴图是一种均匀重采样。
cues.en: It's also worth noting, projecting to normal or displacement maps is a form of uniform resampling.

cues.zh: 对已经均匀采样的有机表面非常有效。
cues.en: Works really well for organic surfaces that are already uniformly sampled.

cues.zh: 但如果艺术家没有非常仔细地控制，就可能对硬表面特征造成很大破坏。
cues.en: But can be really destructive for hard surface features if not careful very carefully controlled by the artist.

cues.zh: 所以它很适合特写和放大，但对于通用简化还不够好。
cues.en: So great for up close and amplification, but not good enough for general purpose simplification.

cues.zh: 基于点的渲染怎么样？
cues.en: How about point-based rendering?

cues.zh: 点刷到屏幕上非常快，但前提是你愿意接受大量过度绘制。
cues.en: Points are super fast to blast to the screen, but unless you accept massive amounts of overdraw.

cues.zh: 点渲染需要补洞。
cues.en: Points require hole filling.

cues.zh: 我们怎么区分本该存在的小间隙和应该填充的空洞？
cues.en: How do we know the difference between a small gap that should be there and a hole that should be filled?

cues.zh: 没有额外的连接数据，也就是索引缓冲和三角网格，就不可能确定。
cues.en: It's impossible to know for certain without extra connectivity data, also known as an index buffer and a triangle mesh.

cues.zh: 我们花了很长时间探索其他方案，但按我们的需求，没找到比三角形质量更高或更快的方案。
cues.en: Spent a very long time exploring other options and for our requirements found no higher quality or faster solution than triangles.

cues.zh: 这些其他表示法有不错的用途，但三角形是 Nanite 的核心。
cues.en: There are good uses for these other representations, but triangles are the core of Nanite.

cues.zh: 如果你能围绕这些其他表示法之一的美学来构建美术风格，并接受其优缺点，它们会非常有价值。
cues.en: If you can build an art style around the aesthetics of one of these other representations and embrace their pros and cons, they can be incredibly valuable.

cues.zh: 但 Unreal 无法强加一种美术风格。
cues.en: But Unreal can't impose an art style.

cues.zh: 好吧，如果我们要做三角形，那构建顶尖的三角形渲染管线需要什么？
cues.en: Well, if we're going to do triangles, what does it take to build a state of the art triangle rendering pipeline?

cues.zh: 这里没什么新东西，但我们先快速确立当前最先进水平，并让 Unreal 达到这个水平。
cues.en: Nothing novel here, but let's quickly establish the state of the art and bring Unreal up to it.

cues.zh: 几年前，Unreal 的渲染器被重构为保留模式设计。
cues.en: As of a few years ago, Unreal's renderer was refactored to a retain mode design.

cues.zh: 我们在此基础上做了扩展。
cues.en: We've expanded on this.

cues.zh: 场景的完整版本存储在显存中，并跨帧持续存在。
cues.en: A complete version of the scene is stored in video memory and persists across frames.

cues.zh: 它只在发生变化的地方做稀疏更新。
cues.en: It is sparsely updated where things change.

cues.zh: 此外，所有 Nanite 网格数据都存储在单个大型资源中。
cues.en: In addition, all Nanite mesh data is stored in single large resources.

cues.zh: 这意味着我们可以一次访问其中任意部分，而无需为此使用无绑定资源。
cues.en: This means we can touch any of it at once without requiring bindless resources to do so.

cues.zh: 这些是 GPU 驱动管线的必要构建块。
cues.en: These are necessary building blocks for GPU driven pipeline.

cues.zh: 对于每个视图，我们可以在单次 dispatch 中确定可见实例。
cues.en: For each view, we can determine the visible instances in a single dispatch.

cues.zh: 然后，如果我们只绘制深度，就可以用一次 draw indirect 把所有三角形光栅化。
cues.en: And then, if we are only drawing depth, we can rasterize all the triangles with a single draw indirect.

cues.zh: 现在我们有了 GPU 驱动的全部好处，但对于不可见的三角形，仍然做了相当多的工作。
cues.en: We have all the benefits of GPU driven now, but we are still doing a fair amount of work for triangles that aren't visible.

cues.zh: 那就加入三角形簇剔除，把不必要的工作裁掉。
cues.en: So let's add triangle cluster culling which trims out that unnecessary work.

cues.zh: 做法是把三角形分组为簇，并为每个簇构建包围盒。
cues.en: To do that, group the triangles into clusters and build a bounding box for each cluster.

cues.zh: 然后就可以根据包围盒剔除这些簇。
cues.en: Then we can cull the clusters based on their bounds.

cues.zh: 我们既可以做视锥剔除，也可以做遮挡剔除。
cues.en: We can cull them against the frustum as well as occlusion cull.

cues.zh: 我们发现，基于锥体的背面剔除通常不值得做，因为几乎所有背面朝向的簇反正都会被遮挡剔除掉。
cues.en: We found that cone based back face culling is not typically worthwhile as almost all back facing clusters are occlusion culled anyways.

cues.zh: 遮挡剔除是针对层级 Z 缓冲进行的，我将其称为 HZB。
cues.en: Occlusion occlusion culling is done against a hierarchical Z buffer, I'll refer to as HZB.

cues.zh: 计算包围盒的屏幕矩形，找到矩形为 4x4 像素的最低 mip 层级，并测试它是否被遮挡。
cues.en: Calculate a screen wreck for the bounds, find the lowest mip where the recked is 4x4 pixels and test if it is occluded.

cues.zh: 好，但我们怎么得到一个可用于测试的 HZB 呢？
cues.en: Okay, but how do we get an HZB to test against?

cues.zh: 我们还没渲染任何东西。
cues.en: We haven't rendered anything yet.

cues.zh: 有些游戏尝试把上一帧的 Z 缓冲区重投影到当前帧。
cues.en: Some games have tried to reproject the previous frame's Z buffer into the current frame.

cues.zh: 这始终是近似的，而且不保守。
cues.en: This is always approximate and not conservative.

cues.zh: 不过，这个核心假设本身是合理的。
cues.en: The core assumption there is a good one, though.

cues.zh: 上一帧可见的内容，很可能这一帧也可见。
cues.en: What was visible last frame is very likely to be what is visible this frame.

cues.zh: 所以，用深度缓冲区表示的上一帧可见表面，很适合作为遮挡体。
cues.en: So last frame's visible surfaces are represented by the depth buffer are a good choice for occluders.

cues.zh: 但既然我们可以改为重投影渲染到深度缓冲区的几何体，为什么还要重投影深度缓冲区呢？
cues.en: But why try to reproject the depth buffer when we can instead reproject the geometry that we rendered to the depth buffer?

cues.zh: 所以，把上一帧判定为可见的内容画出来，用它遮挡任何新出现的东西。
cues.en: So draw what we determined was visible last frame and use that to occlude anything new.

cues.zh: 这就是两遍遮挡剔除，流程如下。
cues.en: This is two-pass occlusion culling which goes like this.

cues.zh: 先绘制上一帧中可见的内容，并据此构建 HZB。
cues.en: Draw what was visible in the previous frame, build HZB from that.

cues.zh: 用 HZB 测试确定当前可见、但上一帧不可见的内容，并绘制所有新增部分。
cues.en: Test the HZB to determine what was visible now, but wasn't in the last frame and draw anything that's new.

cues.zh: 这样我们就有了最先进的三角形渲染管线，接下来呢？
cues.en: With that we now have a state-of-the-art triangle rendering pipeline, what next?

cues.zh: 显然，我们想渲染的不只是仅深度通道。
cues.en: Obviously, we want to render more than just a depth-only pass.

cues.zh: 我们希望超越仅深度，也支持材质；有很多方案，但我们更倾向于将可见性与材质解耦的方案。
cues.en: We want to move past depth-only and support materials too, there are many options, but we would prefer an option where we decouple visibility from materials.

cues.zh: 也就是说，逐像素确定可见性，这正是深度缓冲光栅化所做的。
cues.en: By that, I mean determining visibility per pixel, which is what depth-buffered rasterization does.

cues.zh: 它与材质求值相互独立。
cues.en: It's disconnected from the material evaluation.

cues.zh: 我们这样做的原因，是为了消除光栅化过程中的着色器切换。
cues.en: The reasons we want this are to eliminate switching of shaders during rasterization.

cues.zh: 材质求值造成的过度绘制，或者用深度预通道来避免这种过度绘制。
cues.en: Overdraw of material evaluation or a depth pre-pass that would avoid that overdraw.

cues.zh: 以及密集网格导致的像素四边形效率问题。
cues.en: And pixel quad inefficiencies from dense meshes.

cues.zh: 而且我们想绘制非常密集的网格。
cues.en: And we want to draw very dense meshes.

cues.zh: 所以有几种方案可以满足这些需求。
cues.en: So there are a few options to fulfill these.

cues.zh: 物体空间着色，可以是光线形式，也可以是纹理空间形式。
cues.en: Object space shading, either in the form of rays or texture space.

cues.zh: 但任何形式的物体空间方案通常都会过度着色，幅度达 4 倍甚至更多。
cues.en: But object space solutions of any form overshade usually by a substantial factor 4x or more.

cues.zh: 通过缓存解决过度着色开销很有吸引力，但它是视角相关的。
cues.en: Solving the overshade cost through caching is very attractive, but view-dependent.

cues.zh: 带动画的材质和不依赖 UV 的材质太常见了。
cues.en: Animating and non-UV-based materials are too prevalent.

cues.zh: 以至于我们不能把渲染基础建立在无法很好支持它们的方案上。
cues.en: For us to build our rendering foundation on something that doesn't support them well.

cues.zh: 另一个选项是延迟材质。
cues.en: The other option is deferred materials.

cues.zh: 这对我们来说是最佳选择，具体形式是可见性缓冲区。
cues.en: This was the best choice for us, specifically in the form of a visibility buffer.

cues.zh: 这里的基本思路是，以深度、实例 ID 和三角形 ID 的形式，向屏幕写入尽可能少的几何信息。
cues.en: Basic idea here is to write the smallest amount of geometry to the screen in the form of depth, instance ID, and triangle ID.

cues.zh: 然后，每个像素的材质着色器会加载可见性缓冲区，并加载三角形数据。
cues.en: Then a material shader per pixel loads the vis buffer, loads the triangle data.

cues.zh: 把三个顶点位置变换到屏幕空间，再用它们推导出该像素的重心坐标。
cues.en: Transforms the three vertex positions to the screen, uses those to derive barycentric coordinates for this pixel.

cues.zh: 然后利用这些坐标加载并插值顶点属性。
cues.en: And with those, loads and interpolates the vertex attributes.

cues.zh: 这听起来很疯狂，对吧？
cues.en: That sounds crazy, doesn't it?

cues.zh: 但它并没有看起来那么慢。
cues.en: But it's not as slow as it seems.

cues.zh: 会有大量缓存命中，也没有过度绘制或像素 quad 低效的问题。
cues.en: There's a lot of cache hits and no overdraw or pixel quad inefficiencies.

cues.zh: 通常，可见性缓冲区方案会把材质求值与着色结合起来。
cues.en: Typically, the visibility buffer approach would combine with material evaluation with shading.

cues.zh: 但在我们的方案中，我们会写入 G-buffer。
cues.en: But in our case, we write to the to a G buffer.

cues.zh: 这样做是为了与我们延迟着色渲染器的其余部分集成。
cues.en: This was to integrate with the rest of our deferred shading renderer.

cues.zh: 我们仍有充分理由继续采用延迟渲染，但这里就不展开了。
cues.en: We still have good reasons to stay deferred, but I won't get into that here.

cues.zh: 所以现在只需一次绘制调用就能绘制所有不透明几何体。
cues.en: So now we can draw all opaque geometry with a single draw call.

cues.zh: 完全由 GPU 驱动，不再局限于深度预通道。
cues.en: Completely GPU driven, not restricted to just the depth pre-pass.

cues.zh: CPU 开销与场景中或视野中的对象数量无关。
cues.en: CPU cost is independent from number of objects in the scene or in view.

cues.zh: 材质按着色器各需一次绘制，但数量远少于对象。
cues.en: Materials are a draw per shader, but those are far fewer than objects.

cues.zh: 另一个便利之处是，每个视图只需光栅化三角形一次。
cues.en: It is also convenient that we only need to rasterize triangles once per view.

cues.zh: 无需通过多次光栅化通道来减少过度绘制。
cues.en: No need for multiple rasterization passes to reduce overdraw.

cues.zh: 它比之前快得多，但仍会随实例数和三角形数线性扩展。
cues.en: It's much faster than before, but still scales linearly in both instance and triangle count.

cues.zh: 线性扩展和实例化是可以接受的。
cues.en: Linear scaling and instances can be okay.

cues.zh: 至少在你通常希望周围加载的关卡规模范围内是如此。
cues.en: At least within the limit of scale of the level that you typically want to have loaded around you.

cues.zh: 我们可以轻松处理一百万个实例。
cues.en: We can handle a million instances easily.

cues.zh: 三角形数量线性增长可不行。
cues.en: Linear scaling and triangles is not okay.

cues.zh: 如果还是线性扩展，无论投入多少资源，都无法实现“开箱即用”的目标。
cues.en: We can't achieve our goals of just works, no matter how much you throw at it, if we scale linearly.

cues.zh: 光线追踪是 log N，这很好，但还不够。
cues.en: Ray tracing is login, which is nice, but not enough.

cues.zh: 即使能渲染得足够快，这些场景的全部数据也放不进内存。
cues.en: We couldn't fit all of the data of these scenes in memory, even if we could render it fast enough.

cues.zh: 虚拟几何体在一定程度上就是内存问题。
cues.en: Virtual geometry is partly about memory.

cues.zh: 但即使能放进内存，光线追踪对我们的目标来说也不够快。
cues.en: But ray tracing isn't fast enough for our target, even if it fit in memory.

cues.zh: 我们需要比 log N 更好的方案。
cues.en: We need better than Login.

cues.zh: 换个角度想，屏幕上的像素就那么多。
cues.en: To think about it another way, there are only so many pixels on screen.

cues.zh: 为什么要画的三角形比像素还多？
cues.en: Why should we draw more triangles than pixels?

cues.zh: 就簇而言，我们希望每帧绘制相同数量的簇，不管对象有多少、密度有多高。
cues.en: In terms of clusters, we want to draw the same number of clusters every frame, regardless of how many objects are or how dense they are.

cues.zh: 在这里做到完美并不现实，但总体而言，渲染几何体的开销应当能按比例缩放。
cues.en: It's impractical to be perfect here, but in general the cost of rendering geometry should scale.

cues.zh: 随屏幕分辨率缩放，而不是随场景复杂度缩放。
cues.en: With screen resolution, not scene complexity.

cues.zh: 这意味着就场景复杂度而言是常数时间。
cues.en: That means constant time in terms of scene complexity.

cues.zh: 而常数时间就意味着细节层次（LOD）。
cues.en: And constant time means level of detail.

cues.zh: 我们也可以用簇来实现细节层次，只要把它们组织成层级结构。
cues.en: We can do level of detail with clusters too, if we build a hierarchy out of them.

cues.zh: 最基础的形式，想象一棵由簇构成的树，父节点是子节点的简化版本。
cues.en: In the most basic form, imagine a tree of clusters where the parents are simplified versions of their children.

cues.zh: 在运行时，我们找到树的一个切割，使其匹配所需的 LOD。
cues.en: At runtime, we find a cut of the tree that matches the desired LOD.

cues.zh: 这意味着同一个网格的不同部分可以根据需要处于不同的细节层次。
cues.en: That means different parts of the same mesh can be at different levels of detail based on what's needed.

cues.zh: 这是基于簇的屏幕空间投影误差、以视点相关的方式完成的。
cues.en: This is done in a view-dependent way based on screen space projected error of the cluster.

cues.zh: 如果我们判断从这个视角看不出区别，就绘制父节点而不是它的子节点。
cues.en: A parent will draw instead of its children if we determine that you couldn't tell the difference from this point of view.

cues.zh: 这提供了实现虚拟几何中虚拟化部分所需的一切。
cues.en: This gives us all we need to achieve the virtualized part of virtual geometry.

cues.zh: 渲染时不需要把整棵树同时放进内存。
cues.en: We don't need the entire tree in memory at once to render it.

cues.zh: 我们可以随时把树的某个切割位置标记为叶子，不再把该位置之后的内容存到内存里。
cues.en: We can at any point mark a cut of the tree as leaves and not store anything past it in RAM.

cues.zh: 和虚拟纹理一样，我们按需请求数据。
cues.en: Just like virtual texturing, we request data based on demand.

cues.zh: 如果子节点尚未驻留内存而我们需要它们，就会从磁盘请求。
cues.en: If we don't have the children resident and want them, they're requested from disk.

cues.zh: 如果子节点已驻留内存，但有一段时间没被绘制，就可以将它们逐出。
cues.en: If we have the children resident but haven't drawn them in a while, we can evict them.

cues.zh: 好，这是高层概念，但这个简单想法在实践中行不通，因为会出现裂缝。
cues.en: Okay, that's the high-level concept, but this simplistic idea doesn't work in practice due due to cracks.

cues.zh: 当独立簇做出不同的 LOD 决策，且它们边界处的边不再匹配时，就会形成裂缝。
cues.en: Cracks form when independent clusters make different LOD decisions and the edges at their boundaries no longer match.

cues.zh: 这个问题的朴素解法是在简化过程中锁定簇之间共享的边界边。
cues.en: The naive solution to this problem is to lock the shared boundary edges between clusters during simplification.

cues.zh: 这样，独立簇在边界处就总能匹配，因为我们强制边界不发生变化。
cues.en: This way independent clusters will always match at their boundaries because we force the boundaries not to change.

cues.zh: 不过，这种做法效果很差，因为相同的边界会在许多层级上持续存在，密集的三角形冗余会堆积在那里。
cues.en: This works really poorly, though, because the same boundaries persist over many levels and dense triangle cruft collects there.

cues.zh: 如果你能画一条线穿过多个层级而不穿过任何边，那你就找到了一个边界。
cues.en: If you can draw a line through many levels of the hierarchy without crossing an edge, you just found a boundary.

cues.zh: 这个边界会被锁定，并且在它没有跨过边的每一层都不会被简化。
cues.en: That will be locked and won't be simplified for every level it doesn't cross an edge.

cues.zh: 对于平衡树，你可以沿中间画这样一条线，从 LOD 0 一直画到根节点。
cues.en: With a balanced tree, you could draw such a line down the middle from LOD zero all the way to the root.

cues.zh: 这些子树之间的边界上会有太多冗余，以至于每层甚至无法保留三角形，整个结构会彻底崩溃。
cues.en: There will be so much cruft on the boundary between these sub-trees that you won't be able to even have the triangles per level and it completely breaks down.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，我们可以在构建过程中检测到这些情况。
cues.en: Thankfully, we can detect these cases during the build.

cues.zh: 我们可以把多个簇分组，并强制它们在一个层级上做出相同的 LOD 决策。
cues.en: We can group clusters and force them to make the same LOD decisions for a level.

cues.zh: 这意味着它们不再相互独立。
cues.en: That means they are no longer independent.

cues.zh: 如果它们总是做相同的 LOD 决策，就不会出现不一致。
cues.en: If they always make the same LOD decision, then they can't mismatch.

cues.zh: 裂缝来自相邻簇之间的层级差异，所以没有层级差异就不可能产生裂缝。
cues.en: Cracks come from differences in level between neighboring clusters, so no difference in level means no possibility for cracks.

cues.zh: 现在我们可以放心解锁簇之间的任意共享边，并在简化时像处理内部边一样把它们坍缩掉。
cues.en: We are now free to unlock any shared edges between the clusters and collapse them during simplification, just like they were interior edges.

cues.zh: 当然，我们不能把一个层级的所有簇都分到一组，否则就退回到老式的离散 LOD 了。
cues.en: Now, obviously we can't group all clusters for a level or we get back to good old discrete LODs.

cues.zh: 所以我们只在需要时才对簇进行分组。
cues.en: So we need to group clusters only when needed.

cues.zh: 这是一个概念示意图，展示了它在多个层级上的样子。
cues.en: Here's a conceptual visualization for what this looks like over multiple levels.

cues.zh: 这些线表示分组边界，也就是在简化各组时会被锁定的边。
cues.en: These lines represent the group boundaries and hence the edges that will be locked during simplification of the groups.

cues.zh: 从第零层开始。
cues.en: Starting with level zero.

cues.zh: 关键思路是：逐层交替分组边界，把不同的簇分到一组。
cues.en: The key idea is to alternate group boundaries from level to level, grouping different clusters.

cues.zh: 现在到第一层。
cues.en: Now at level one.

cues.zh: 某一层中的边界，在下一层中就变成了内部。
cues.en: What is what is a boundary in one level becomes the interior in the next level.

cues.zh: 第二层。
cues.en: Level two.

cues.zh: 这意味着，边界上的锁定边不会在多层之间一直保持锁定，因为它们并不是相同的边界。
cues.en: That means locked edges on the boundaries don't stay locked over many levels because they aren't the same boundaries.

cues.zh: 因此它们无法积累密集的冗余。
cues.en: Thus they can't collect dense cruft.

cues.zh: 一层锁定，下一层解锁。
cues.en: Locked one level, unlock the next.

cues.zh: 好，那么构建操作就是这些。
cues.en: Okay, so here are what the build operations are.

cues.zh: 首先需要构建叶子簇；在我们的场景中，一个簇是 128 个三角形。
cues.en: First we need to build the leaf clusters, in our case, a cluster is 128 triangles.

cues.zh: 然后对每个 LOD 层级，我们把簇分组以清理它们的共享边界，把该组中的三角形合并到一个共享列表，简化到三角形数量的一半，再把简化后的三角形列表重新拆分成簇。
cues.en: Then for each LOD level, we group clusters to clean their shared boundary, merge the the triangles from the group into a shared list, simplify to half the number of triangles, then split the simplified list of triangles back into clusters.

cues.zh: 重复这个过程，直到根节点只剩下一个簇。
cues.en: Repeat this process until there is only one cluster left at the root.

cues.zh: 这是该过程的图示。
cues.en: Here's an illustration of the process.

cues.zh: 在这个例子中，我们将这四个相邻的簇分到一组，对应的 DAG 在底部。
cues.en: In this example, we have grouped these four adjacent clusters, the corresponding DAG is at the bottom.

cues.zh: 下一步，这些簇被合并，并简化到三角形数量的一半。
cues.en: In the next step, the clusters are merged and simplified to half the number of triangles.

cues.zh: 在 DAG 中，这对应于四个节点将这个新的简化网格作为它们的父节点。
cues.en: In the DAG, this corresponds to four nodes getting this new simplified mesh as their parent.

cues.zh: 注意边界被锁定，因此我们没有与原始网格中的任何相邻簇产生裂缝。
cues.en: Note that the boundary is locked, so we have not caused any cracks with any neighboring clusters in the original mesh.

cues.zh: 最后，简化后的三角形列表被重新拆分成两个新的簇。
cues.en: Finally, the simplified triangle list is split back into two new clusters.

cues.zh: 在 DAG 中，这对应于将父节点一分为二，同时所有子节点仍连接到两个父节点。
cues.en: In the DAG, this corresponds to splitting the parent in two while all children are still connected to both parents.

cues.zh: 现在我们把四个各含四个三角形的簇，缩减为两个各含四个三角形的簇。
cues.en: We've now reduced four, four triangle clusters to two, four triangle clusters.

cues.zh: 我们把它们放回池中，供分组时选择；这个过程持续进行，直到所有内容都归约为 DAG 根节点上的单个簇。
cues.en: We put them back in the pool to choose from for grouping, and the process continues until everything has been reduced to a single cluster at the root of the DAG.

cues.zh: 合并和拆分步骤使其成为 DAG，而不是树。
cues.en: The merging and splitting steps make this a DAG instead of a tree.

cues.zh: 这是好事，因为你无法从 LOD 0 一路连到根节点而不跨过一条边。
cues.en: This is a good thing in that you can't draw a line from LOD zero all the way to the root without crossing an an edge.

cues.zh: 这意味着不会出现保持锁定并不断累积冗余的锁定边。
cues.en: Meaning there can't be locked edges that stay locked and collect cruft.

cues.zh: 我们逐步过一遍构建操作的每个步骤。
cues.en: Let's walk through each step of the build operations.

cues.zh: 首先，我们如何决定合并哪些组、哪些簇？
cues.en: First, how do we decide which groups, which clusters to group?

cues.zh: 我们会合并共享边界边最多的那些，因为边界边越少，锁定边就越少。
cues.en: We group those with the most shared boundary edges because the less boundary edges we have, the less locked edges we have.

cues.zh: 锁定边越少越好，因为锁定边会限制简化器缩减三角形。
cues.en: The less locked edges the better, because locked edges restrict the simplifier from reducing triangles.

cues.zh: 某种程度上，这是不可能完成的任务，因为在这个阶段我们还不知道这个网格会用什么材质。
cues.en: In some ways, it is an impossible task, because at this stage we don't know what material is applied to this mesh.

cues.zh: 比如，我们不知道它有多反光，就无法判断法线误差的影响；也不知道根据纹理来看，UV 误差会有多明显。
cues.en: For example, we don't know how shiny it is to know the impact of normal error, or how much UV error is apparent based on the texture.

cues.zh: 或者如果有顶点色，它们到底用来做什么。
cues.en: Or if there are vertex colors, what they are even used for.

cues.zh: 我们现在这套方案肯定不完美，也可能出错，只是很少会明显到被注意到。
cues.en: What we have definitely isn't perfect and can fail, although it's rare to be noticeable.

cues.zh: 它当然可以更激进一些，把更多人类感知因素纳入考虑。
cues.en: It certainly could be more aggressive by factoring in more aspects of human perception.

cues.zh: 接下来看运行时部分。
cues.en: Moving on to the runtime portion.

cues.zh: 我们已经构建了这个簇层级结构。
cues.en: We've built this cluster hierarchy.

cues.zh: 每一帧，我们都需要根据视图选择要绘制哪些簇。
cues.en: Each frame we need to select which clusters we're going to draw, based on the view.

cues.zh: 有意思的是，在构建操作的每次迭代中，我们都会生成两组簇：三角形数量不同，但边界相同。
cues.en: The interesting thing is that for each iteration of the build operations, we produced two sets of clusters with a different number of triangles, but with the same boundary.

cues.zh: 因此它们可以在原始网格中互换，而不会产生裂缝。
cues.en: So they're interchangeable in their original mesh without causing cracks.

cues.zh: 这就是细节层次系统的核心。
cues.en: This is the essence of the level of detail system.

cues.zh: 在运行时，我们根据估计的屏幕空间误差在它们之间做选择。
cues.en: At runtime, we choose between them, based on how much screen space error we estimate they have.

cues.zh: 误差由简化器计算，并投影到屏幕上，同时考虑距离和投影角度造成的畸变。
cues.en: Error is calculated by the simplifier, is projected to the screen, accounting for distance and projection angle distortion.

cues.zh: 这一步是在簇周围包围球内、使投影误差最大的点处计算的。
cues.en: This is calculated at the point that maximizes the projected error within a bounding sphere around the cluster.

cues.zh: 如前所述，同一组内的簇必须做出相同的 LOD 决策。
cues.en: As explained before, grouped clusters may make must make the same LOD decision.

cues.zh: 那怎么并行实现呢？
cues.en: How do we do that in parallel?

cues.zh: 做一对多展开，让它们之间相互通信？
cues.en: A one to many expansion, communicate between them?

cues.zh: 不，很简单。
cues.en: No, it's very simple.

cues.zh: 我们用同样的数据来做决策。
cues.en: We use the same data to decide.

cues.zh: 如果用同样的数据决策，它们就会做出相同的决定。
cues.en: If you use the same data to decide, they will decide the same thing.

cues.zh: 相同输入，相同输出。
cues.en: Same input, same output.

cues.zh: 因此，组内所有簇都存储相同的合并误差值，以及用于把该误差投影到屏幕的包围球边界。
cues.en: So all clusters in the group store the same unioned error value and sphere bounds used to project that error to the screen.

cues.zh: 但这只说明这个簇的误差是否足够小、可以绘制。
cues.en: But all that gives us is whether this cluster has a small enough error that we could draw it.

cues.zh: 我们不想绘制所有低误差簇。
cues.en: We don't want to draw all low error clusters.

cues.zh: 其中很多表示同一区域，只是细节层次不同。
cues.en: Many of them represent the same area but at different detail.

cues.zh: LOD 选择需要找到层级结构的一个视点相关切割。
cues.en: LOD selection involves finding a view-dependent cut of the hierarchy.

cues.zh: 而我们现在知道，它实际上是一个 DAG。
cues.en: And we now know that that's actually a DAG.

cues.zh: 我们想在 GPU 上确定这一点，那如何高效地并行计算这个切割？
cues.en: We want to determine this on the GPU, so how can we compute the cut in parallel efficiently?

cues.zh: 值得考虑一下，是什么定义了这个切割。
cues.en: It's worth considering what defines the cut.

cues.zh: 切割发生在这样的点：父节点的误差太高，但子节点的误差足够小，可以合法绘制。
cues.en: The cut happens at the point when a parent's error is too high, but the child's error is small enough to be valid to draw.

cues.zh: 父节点说不行，子节点说行。
cues.en: Parent says no, but child says yes.

cues.zh: 这完全是局部的，不依赖到该节点的整条路径，因此可以并行求值。
cues.en: This is entirely local, does not depend on the entire path to the node, and thus can be evaluated in parallel.

cues.zh: 但这只有在假设存在唯一切割时才成立。
cues.en: But that's only true assuming that there is one unique cut.

cues.zh: 如果不是这样，我们就需要沿路径遍历，找到第一个满足条件的切割。
cues.en: If there wasn't, we'd need to walk the path and find the first one.

cues.zh: 如果从根到叶子的所有路径上，选择函数都只从否切换到是，并且之后不再切回，就会形成唯一的切割。
cues.en: There will be a a unique cut if the selection function for all paths from the root to the leaves switches from no to yes once and never switches back.

cues.zh: 我们的选择函数是视点相关误差函数的阈值化。
cues.en: Our selection function is a thresholding of the view dependent error function.

cues.zh: 保证路径上只发生一次切换，等同于强制每条路径的误差函数都是单调的。
cues.en: Guaranteeing a single transition along the path is the same as forcing the error function of every path to be monotonic.

cues.zh: 这听起来复杂，但实际上意味着我们需要让父节点的误差计算至少不小于子节点。
cues.en: That sounds complicated, but really means that we need to make the error calculation for parents to be at least as large as as the children.

cues.zh: 这一点在离线构建 DAG 时，通过修改父节点存储的误差以及用于投影它的边界来强制实现。
cues.en: This is forced during the offline DAG building by modifying the parent's stored error and bounds used for projecting it.

cues.zh: 这两者都需要至少与子节点一样大。
cues.en: Both need to be as big as their children.

cues.zh: 所以在每一帧中，我们要么选择父节点，要么选择子节点。
cues.en: So in each frame, we are selecting either the parent or the child.

cues.zh: 切换时不会明显跳变吗？
cues.en: Won't this visibly pop when it switches?

cues.zh: 需要用 geomorphing 或 crossfading 来平滑过渡吗？
cues.en: Do we need to smooth transitions with geomorphing or crossfading?

cues.zh: 那在渲染时会很昂贵，或者需要大量额外数据，或者两者都需要。
cues.en: That would be expensive at render time or require significant additional data or both.

cues.zh: 但如果我们只绘制误差小于一个像素的簇，它们的差异就难以察觉，时间抗锯齿会抹平任何变化。
cues.en: But if we only draw clusters that are less than one pixel of error, they are imperceptibly different and temporal antialiasing smooths out any change.

cues.zh: TAA 就是为在时间上混合亚像素差异而设计的。
cues.en: TAA is built to blend sub-pixel differences over time.

cues.zh: 只要误差是亚像素级，它就会替我们完成工作。
cues.en: It does our work for us, so long as the error is sub-pixel.

cues.zh: 这就是为什么获得准确的误差估计如此重要。
cues.en: This is the reason why getting an accurate error estimate is so important.

cues.zh: 如前所述，我们可以让簇选择完全并行，但规模扩大后会变得极其浪费。
cues.en: As explained, we can make cluster selection perfectly parallel, but it turns out to be extremely wasteful when scaled up.

cues.zh: 对于大型场景，绝大多数簇都过于精细，不会被选中。
cues.en: For large scenes, the vast majority of clusters are too detailed to be selected.

cues.zh: 我们根本不该考虑其中大多数。
cues.en: We shouldn't even be considering most of them.

cues.zh: 为了快速剔除，我们需要一种层次结构。
cues.en: For quick rejection, we need a hierarchy.

cues.zh: 最自然的做法是基于 DAG 结构，但遍历 DAG 比我们希望的要复杂。
cues.en: The most natural thing would be to base it on the DAG structure, but traversing a DAG is more complicated than we would like.

cues.zh: 尤其当它必须并行执行时。
cues.en: Especially if it has to happen in parallel.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，正如刚才所示，LOD 判定可以局部评估，只需用到簇误差和父级误差。
cues.en: Luckily, as we have just shown, the LOD decision can be evaluated locally, using just the cluster error and the parent error.

cues.zh: 所以我们完全不需要使用 DAG。
cues.en: So we don't need to use the DAG at all.

cues.zh: 我们可以构建任意数据结构来加速这些测试。
cues.en: We can build any data structure to accelerate these tests.

cues.zh: 我们能剔除的簇，正是之前未通过 LOD 选择测试的那些。
cues.en: The clusters we can cull are exactly the ones that fail the LOD selection test from before.

cues.zh: 任何父级误差已经足够小的簇都可以被剔除。
cues.en: Any cluster whose parent error is already small enough can be culled.

cues.zh: 有趣的是，这意味着用于 LOD 剔除的加速结构应基于父级误差，而不是簇误差本身。
cues.en: Interestingly, that means that an acceleration structure for LOD calling should be based on parent error, not the cluster error itself.

cues.zh: 据此，我们在这些簇之上构建 BVH。
cues.en: With that we build a BVH over the clusters.

cues.zh: 与任何 BVH 一样，父节点会保守地包围其子节点；在这种情况下，包围范围还包括父节点误差。
cues.en: As with any BVH, the parents conservatively bound their children, which in this case also includes parent error.

cues.zh: 在这种情况下，这也包含父节点误差。
cues.en: Which in this case also includes parent error.

cues.zh: 因为 BVH 遍历可能很深，而任一时刻的活跃节点数相对于 GPU 的并行宽度可能相当少。
cues.en: Because the BVH traversal can go deep, and the number of active nodes at a given time can be relatively small, relative to the width of the of the GPU.

cues.zh: BVH 剔除阶段并不总能填满 GPU。
cues.en: The BVH calling phase will not always be able to fill the GPU.

cues.zh: 在这种情况下，少数深度遍历的延迟最终可能主导剔除执行时间。
cues.en: When that is the case, then the latency of a few deep traversals can end up dominating the calling execution time.

cues.zh: 为缓解这个问题，我们将簇剔除集成到了持久化层级剔除着色器中。
cues.en: To mitigate this, we have integrated the cluster calling into the persistent hierarchy calling shader.

cues.zh: 这样簇剔除就可以提前开始，并填补 BVH 剔除中的空洞。
cues.en: So that cluster calling can be started early, and fill out holes in the BVH calling.

cues.zh: 在实践中，这通过一个额外的簇队列来实现。
cues.en: In practice, this is implemented with an additional queue of clusters.

cues.zh: 当一个 worker 在等待节点队列中出现新节点时，它可以处理簇队列中已经找到的簇。
cues.en: While a worker is waiting for new nodes to appear in the node queue, it can process already found clusters in the cluster queue.

cues.zh: 为避免发散，这一操作是分批进行的。
cues.en: To avoid divergence, this is done in batches.

cues.zh: 显然，当我们在为 LOD 做剔除时，也应该基于可见性进行剔除。
cues.en: Now obviously while we're doing all this calling for LOD, we should also call based on visibility.

cues.zh: 不过，我之前解释的两遍遮挡方法有一个问题。
cues.en: There's an issue though with the two pass occlusion method I previously explained.

cues.zh: 跟踪之前的可见集合会变得很复杂。
cues.en: Tracking the previously visible set gets complicated.

cues.zh: 逐帧的 LOD 选择很可能不同，而且由于流式加载，上一帧的可见簇甚至可能已经不在内存中。
cues.en: LOD selection from frame to frame is likely different and visible clusters from last frame might not even be in memory anymore due to streaming.

cues.zh: 因此，我们改为测试当前选中的簇在上一帧是否本会可见。
cues.en: So instead we test if the currently selected clusters would have been visible in the last frame.

cues.zh: 为此，我们用上一帧的变换，把它们的包围盒与上一帧的 HCB 进行测试。
cues.en: To do that, we test their bounds against the previous frame's HCB using the previous frames transforms.

cues.zh: 因此，两遍方案现在看起来是这样的。
cues.en: So the two-pass solution now looks like this.

cues.zh: 用上一帧的变换测试上一帧的 HZB，绘制可见内容，把被遮挡的保存起来供后续使用。
cues.en: Test the previous HZB with the previous transform, draw what is visible, save the occluded for later.

cues.zh: 然后依据深度缓冲区，为本帧构建一个初始 HZB。
cues.en: Then build an initial HZB for this frame from the depth buffer.

cues.zh: 利用这个 HZB，再次测试我们先前认为被遮挡的内容，绘制现在可见但之前被遮挡的内容，并绘制所有新增内容。
cues.en: Using this HZB, test what we thought was occluded again, draw what is now visible, but was previously occluded and draw anything that's new.

cues.zh: 最后，根据此时完整的深度缓冲区构建完整的 HZB，供下一帧使用。
cues.en: Finally, build the complete HZB from the now complete depth buffer to use in the next frame.

cues.zh: 由于这一切，我们最终几乎要把整个 Nanite 管线跑两遍。
cues.en: Because of all this, we end up running almost the entire Nanite pipeline twice.

cues.zh: 其中第二遍本质上只是清理解除遮挡的区域。
cues.en: Where the second pass is essentially just cleaning up the disoccluded regions.

cues.zh: 不过也没听起来那么糟，因为第二遍通常只占主遍很小一部分。
cues.en: This is not quite as bad as it sounds though, as the second pass is usually a tiny fraction of the main pass.

cues.zh: 注意，任何与遮挡无关的剔除只需要评估一次。
cues.en: Note that any calling not related to occlusion only needs to be evaluated once.

cues.zh: 因此，视锥体和 LOD 剔除只在第一遍中进行。
cues.en: So frostum and LOD calling is only done in the first pass.

cues.zh: 把这一切合在一起，剔除流程就是这样。
cues.en: Putting it all together, this is what the calling flow looks like.

cues.zh: 第一遍利用上一帧的变换，对照上一帧的 HZB 来评估遮挡。
cues.en: The first pass evaluates occlusion using the previous frame's transforms against the previous frame's HZB.

cues.zh: 它从 GPU 场景中的实例开始，按实例逐个评估可见性。
cues.en: It starts with instances in the GPU scene evaluating visibility on a per-instance basis.

cues.zh: 可见实例随后进入 persistent threads 的层级簇剔除。
cues.en: Visible instances then go to the persistent threads hierarchical cluster calling.

cues.zh: 这一步同时进行 LOD 和可见性剔除，并输出可见簇，随后将它们光栅化到可见性缓冲区。
cues.en: This does both LOD and visibility, and outputs visible clusters, which are then rasterized to the visibility buffer.

cues.zh: HZB 是基于刚刚完成光栅化的内容，为当前帧构建的。
cues.en: HZB is built for the current frame based on what was just rasterized.

cues.zh: 然后重复所有剔除阶段：根据上一帧信息判定为被遮挡的实例、节点和簇，会用当前帧 HZB 和当前变换重新检测。
cues.en: Then all of the calling stages are repeated, where instances, nodes, and clusters found to be occluded, based on the previous frame information, are re-tested with the current frame HZB and current transforms.

cues.zh: 现在有了完整的可见性缓冲区，我们为下一帧构建 HZB，并应用延迟材质通道。
cues.en: Now with the complete visibility buffer, we build the HZB for the next frame and apply the deferred material passes.

cues.zh: 现在我们有了细粒度、视点相关的 LOD，基本上只需随屏幕分辨率扩展。
cues.en: Now that we have fine-grained view-dependent LOD, we are mostly scaling with screen resolution.

cues.zh: 我们需要绘制多少个三角形？
cues.en: How many triangles do we need to draw?

cues.zh: 记住，我们想要细节上零感知损失。
cues.en: Remember, we want zero perceptual loss of detail.

cues.zh: 三角形需要多小，才能让误差小于一个像素、实际上无损？
cues.en: How small do triangles need to be such that the error is less than a pixel big and is effectively lossless?

cues.zh: 能否用比像素更大的三角形做到这一点？
cues.en: Can we do that with triangles that are larger than pixels?

cues.zh: 很多情况下，是的。
cues.en: In a lot of cases, yes.

cues.zh: 三角形是自适应的，可以出现在需要的地方。
cues.en: Triangles are adaptive and can go where they're needed.

cues.zh: 但一般来说，不行。
cues.en: But in general, no.

cues.zh: 像素大小的特征需要像素大小的三角形，才能无可见误差地表示出来。
cues.en: Pixel-sized features need pixel-sized triangles to represent them without visible error.

cues.zh: 那这实用吗？
cues.en: So is that practical?

cues.zh: 微小三角形对典型的光栅化器非常糟糕，硬件光栅化器也不例外。
cues.en: Tiny triangles are terrible for a typical rasterizer, hardware rasterizers included.

cues.zh: 它们的设计是在像素上高度并行，而不是在三角形上，因为那才是它们的典型工作负载。
cues.en: They are designed to be highly parallel in pixels, not triangles, since that's their typical workload.

cues.zh: 现代 GPU 每时钟最多装配四个三角形，而输出可见性缓冲区所需的图元 ID 会让情况更糟。
cues.en: Modern GPUs set up four triangles per clock max and outputting primitive ID needed for the visibility buffer makes this even worse.

cues.zh: 图元着色器或网格着色器可以更快，但仍受瓶颈限制，且并非为此设计。
cues.en: Primitive shaders or mesh shaders can be faster, but are still bottlenecked and not designed for this.

cues.zh: 我们能用软件光栅化器击败硬件吗？
cues.en: Could we possibly beat the hardware with a software rasterizer?

cues.zh: 可以。
cues.en: Yes.

cues.zh: 我们可以做得好得多。
cues.en: We can do a lot better.

cues.zh: 与我们最快的图元着色器实现相比，平均比硬件快 3 倍。
cues.en: 3x faster than have than hardware on average compared to our fastest primitive shader implementation.

cues.zh: 对于纯 micropoly 的情况还要更快；与旧的顶点着色器、像素着色器路径相比，也快不少。
cues.en: Even more for pure micropoly cases and quite a bit more if compared to the old vertex shader, pixel shader path.

cues.zh: 为什么？
cues.en: Why?

cues.zh: 怎么做？
cues.en: How?

cues.zh: 我不是硬件工程师，但只看典型光栅化器要做的所有操作，
cues.en: I'm not a hardware engineer, but just looking at all the operations a typical rasterizer does.

cues.zh: 其中大量操作不适用于我们的场景，或者对微小三角形来说效率极低。
cues.en: A ton of it doesn't apply to our case, or is incredibly inefficient to do for tiny triangles.

cues.zh: 它们是为覆盖很多像素的较大三角形优化的。
cues.en: They are optimized for larger triangles which cover many pixels.

cues.zh: 并行化的关键是对像素进行遍历。
cues.en: The key thing to parallelize is running over pixels.

cues.zh: 我们有很多三角形，每个只覆盖几个像素。
cues.en: We have many triangles which only cover a few pixels each.

cues.zh: 我们希望广泛地并行处理三角形，而不是像素。
cues.en: We want to run wide over the triangles, not pixels.

cues.zh: 当然，可以造出比我们功耗更低的硬件来做这件事，但这是否是晶体管的最佳用途值得怀疑——不如给我们更多通用计算单元，用于这件事或任何其他事。
cues.en: Certainly hardware could be built to do this at lower power than us, but it's questionable if that's the best use of transistors versus giving us more general compute units we could use for this or anything else.

cues.zh: 如果放弃硬件光栅化，我们也会失去 ROP 和深度测试硬件，但仍然需要 Z-buffer。
cues.en: If we forego hardware rasterization, we also lose the ROP and the depth test hardware, but we still need the Z-buffer.

cues.zh: 我们当然不想像某些软件光栅化器那样锁定图块。
cues.en: We certainly don't want to lock tiles like some software rasterizers do.

cues.zh: 许多三角形会同时尝试写入同一个图块，甚至同一个像素。
cues.en: Many triangles will be in flight trying to write to a tile at once or even to a single pixel.

cues.zh: 我们真的根本不想加锁。
cues.en: We really don't want to lock at all.

cues.zh: 相反，我们使用 64 位原子操作。
cues.en: Instead, we use 64-bit atomics.

cues.zh: 具体来说，是向可见性缓冲区执行全局图像 interlocked max。
cues.en: Specifically, a global image interlocked max to the visibility buffer.

cues.zh: 这个 64 位整数的高位是深度，从而实现了深度测试；低位是载荷。
cues.en: This 64-bit integer has depth in the high bits, which gives us the depth test, and the payload in the low bits.

cues.zh: 在我们的场景中，载荷是可见簇索引和三角形索引。
cues.en: In our case, the payload is the visible cluster index and triangle index.

cues.zh: 有了这个细节，可见性缓冲区才展现出真正的威力。
cues.en: With that detail, the visibility buffer shows its true power.

cues.zh: 载荷需要足够小，才能打包进 34 位或更少。
cues.en: The payload needs to be small enough to pack in 34 bits or less.

cues.zh: 没有它，我们就无法实现快速的软件光栅化。
cues.en: Without that, we wouldn't be able to do fast software rasterization.

cues.zh: 这是我们 micropoly 软件光栅化器的基本概览。
cues.en: Here's a basic view of our micropoly software rasterizer.

cues.zh: 所有花哨的分层分块和 stamp 都被舍弃了。
cues.en: All the fancy hierarchical tiling and stamps gets thrown out the window.

cues.zh: 剩下的就是一个超基础的半空间光栅化器，并且做了指令级微优化。
cues.en: We are left with a super basic half space rasterizer that has been instruction level microoptimized.

cues.zh: 它在结构上有点像网格着色器。
cues.en: It is kind of similar in structure to mesh shaders.

cues.zh: 它共享工作，也就是共享顶点工作，不需要任何变换后缓存。
cues.en: It shares work, vertex work without any need for a post-transform cache.

cues.zh: 线程组大小是 128。
cues.en: Thread group size is 128.

cues.zh: 第一阶段，每个线程映射到簇顶点缓冲区中的一个顶点，执行顶点着色器。
cues.en: In the first phase, a thread is mapped to a vertex shader from the cluster's vertex buffer.

cues.zh: 取出顶点位置，变换后存到组共享内存。
cues.en: Fetch the vertex position, transform it, store it in group shared.

cues.zh: 如果顶点超过 128 个，就再取一个并变换，从而每个簇最多支持 256 个。
cues.en: If there are more than 128 verts, fetch and transform another to support up to 256 per cluster.

cues.zh: 然后在第二阶段，切换到按三角形映射线程，每个三角形一个线程，每个簇最多 128 个三角形。
cues.en: Then in the second phase, switch to a thread mapped for each triangle to each triangle with a max of 128 triangles per cluster.

cues.zh: 获取这个三角形的索引，用这些索引从组共享内存中取出变换后的位置。
cues.en: Fetch the indices for this triangle, use those to fetch the transformed positions from group shared.

cues.zh: 计算该三角形的边方程和深度梯度。
cues.en: Calculate the edge equations and depth gradient for the triangle.

cues.zh: 然后，对包围该三角形的矩形内的所有像素，测试它是否在三角形内；如果在，就写入该像素。
cues.en: Then for all pixels inside the rect bounding this triangle, test if inside the triangle and if so, write the pixel.

cues.zh: 这是一个内层循环，这里是它优化程度稍低时的样子。
cues.en: Here's an inner, here is the inner loop in a slightly less optimized state.

cues.zh: 它会遍历包围矩形内的像素，测试像素中心是否在三条边的内侧。
cues.en: This iterates over the pixels in the bounding rect, tests if the center is inside all three edges.

cues.zh: 如果是，就写入该像素——也就是把深度和载荷打包，对屏幕做原子最大值写入。
cues.en: If so, it writes the pixel which is a which is simply pack the depth with the payload in atomic max it to the screen.

cues.zh: 预计这个循环的迭代次数很少，所以我们不应为了减少迭代而增加任何固定开销。
cues.en: Very few iterations of this loop are expected, so we shouldn't add any fixed overhead trying to reduce it.

cues.zh: 大三角形怎么办？
cues.en: How about big triangles?

cues.zh: 用硬件光栅化器吧，这活儿它很擅长。
cues.en: Use the hardware rasterizer, it's good at that.

cues.zh: 对其他我们不会更快的场景也照此处理，比如裁剪。
cues.en: Do the same for any other cases we wouldn't be faster at such as clipping.

cues.zh: 我们按簇选择软件或硬件，看哪个更快。
cues.en: We choose software or hardware per cluster based on which will be faster.

cues.zh: 在我们的演示中，绝大多数都走软件光栅化。
cues.en: The vast majority are software rasterized in our demos.

cues.zh: 一开始我们担心软件簇和硬件簇之间会出现裂缝，但幸好 DirectX 对光栅化规则有非常严格的规范。
cues.en: We were initially nervous about cracks between software and hardware clusters, but thankfully Direct X has a very strict spec for rasterization rules.

cues.zh: 遵循这套规范，我们就能和硬件完全一致，也就是不会出现像素裂缝。
cues.en: By following that, we can exactly match hardware, meaning no pixel cracks.

cues.zh: 硬件光栅化本可以使用深度测试硬件，但那样就得合并 UAV 版本和渲染目标版本，没法像现在这样异步重叠。
cues.en: We could use the depth test hardware for hardware raster, but then we'd have to merge the UAV version and the render target version and couldn't async overlap them, which we do.

cues.zh: 相反，硬件光栅化器不绑定任何颜色或深度目标，而是像软件光栅化一样直接原子写入 UAV。
cues.en: Instead, the hardware rasterizer doesn't bind any color or depth targets and atomic writes to the UAV exactly the same as software raster.

cues.zh: 三角形大到什么程度算太大？
cues.en: How big of triangles are too big?

cues.zh: 结果发现，用比预期大得多的三角形就能跑赢硬件，远远超过 micropoly 级别。
cues.en: Turns out we can beat the hardware with triangles much bigger than expected, far past micropoly.

cues.zh: 对于三角形长度小于 32 像素的簇，我们用软件光栅化。
cues.en: We software rasterize any clusters whose triangles are less than 32 pixels long.

cues.zh: 结果矩形里要遍历的像素非常多。
cues.en: That turns out to be a lot of pixels in the rect to iterate over.

cues.zh: 最好的情况也只覆盖一半，最坏则一个都不覆盖。
cues.en: Best case, only half of them are covered, worst case, none are.

cues.zh: 这两个极端之间，肯定有我们能做的办法。
cues.en: Surely there's something that we can do between these extremes.

cues.zh: 扫描线会不会更快？
cues.en: Could scanline be faster?

cues.zh: 传统的梯形方法，加上边缘步进之类的，太复杂了。
cues.en: A traditional trapezoid approach with edge walking and all that is complicated.

cues.zh: 咱们别搞得太夸张。
cues.en: Let's not get crazy here.

cues.zh: 但我们是有意让内层循环保持简单，减少额外的三角形设置开销。
cues.en: But purposefully, we are trying to keep the inner loop simple and reduce any extra triangle setup cost.

cues.zh: 我们再来看一下那段代码。
cues.en: Let's take a look at that code again.

cues.zh: 为什么我们要逐个像素测试它是否被覆盖？
cues.en: Why do we need to test each pixel individually to see if it's covered or not?

cues.zh: 我们能不能提前知道这个测试会在哪个 x 区间通过？
cues.en: Can't we know what x interval this test will pass?

cues.zh: 很简单，解出 x 就行。
cues.en: Easy, just solve for x.

cues.zh: 这就是我们的扫描线光栅化器。
cues.en: So here is our scanline rasterizer.

cues.zh: 内层循环不再从 Recmin 迭代到 max，逐个测试像素在内还是在外。
cues.en: Instead of the inner loop iterating from Recmin to max, testing whether this pixel is in or out.

cues.zh: 我们解出能通过的 x 区间，只在这些区间上迭代。
cues.en: We solve for the x interval that passes and only iterate over those.

cues.zh: 虽然由于一次除法，这已经不再是精确的定点运算，但实践中我们还没发现任何问题。
cues.en: Although this isn't exact fixed point math anymore, due to a divide, we haven't found any issues in practice.

cues.zh: 如果 wave 中任一三角形的 x 循环超过四个像素，我们就选择扫描线版本。
cues.en: We choose the scanline version if the x loop is greater than four pixels for any triangle in the wave.

cues.zh: 把我们的方法与 depth call 硬件进行比较很有意思。
cues.en: It is interesting to compare our approach with the depth call hardware.

cues.zh: 光栅化期间不运行材质着色器，所以与材质着色器相关的内容可以先忽略。
cues.en: We don't run material shaders during rasterization, so ignore anything having to do with those.

cues.zh: 接下来我们会讲材质。
cues.en: We'll get to materials next.

cues.zh: 尽管这里不用担心昂贵的像素着色器。
cues.en: Although there aren't expensive pixel shaders to worry about.

cues.zh: 在 micropoly 情形下，三角形就像像素级的工作。
cues.en: In the micropoly case, triangles are like pixel work.

cues.zh: 我们没有逐三角形调用，这就像没有硬件 early Z。
cues.en: We do not have per triangle calling, which is like not having hardware early Z.

cues.zh: 这通常不是问题，但如果表面之间靠得比其 cluster 边界尺寸还近——比如图中的热点——或者布满小孔，就需要以细得多的粒度进行调用才能高效。
cues.en: Now this typically isn't an issue, but cases where surfaces are overlap closer than the size of their cluster bounds, like the hotspots in this image or are riddled with small holes, would require calling at a much finer granularity to be efficient.

cues.zh: “布满小孔”听起来像内容问题，但实际上描述了大多数聚合几何体情形，比如树叶和草。
cues.en: Riddled with holes sounds like a content problem, but actually describes most aggregate geometry cases like leaves and grass.

cues.zh: 过度绘制是 Nanite 在这些情况下表现不佳的众多原因之一。
cues.en: Overdraw is one of many reasons Nanite doesn't perform well with those.

cues.zh: 我们也没有硬件 high Z，不过确实有以 cluster 为粒度的 HZB cluster 调用。
cues.en: We also don't have hardware high Z, although we do have HZB cluster calling at a cluster granularity.

cues.zh: 对于密集网格，cluster 的大小通常与 HCB tile 相近，所以这个类比还挺恰当。
cues.en: For dense meshes, clusters tend to be similar in size to HCB tiles, so the analogy is a decent one.

cues.zh: 可以把它理解为，我们只有 high Z 可用于剔除工作。
cues.en: You can think of it as if we only have high Z to cull work.

cues.zh: 到目前为止，我们只讨论了三角形工作量，但像素填充也可能很昂贵。
cues.en: So far we've only discussed triangle work, but pixel fill can be expensive too.

cues.zh: 网格并不总是密集的。
cues.en: Meshes aren't always dense.

cues.zh: 大三角形意味着大簇，而簇越大，按像素计算的剔除粒度就越粗。
cues.en: Large triangles mean mean large clusters and the larger the clusters, the coarser the calling granularity is in terms of pixels.

cues.zh: 这意味着像素越大，像素过度绘制越严重。
cues.en: This mean as pixels get larger, pixel overdraw increases.

cues.zh: 有意思的是，这意味着有些情况下画更多三角形反而更快。
cues.en: Interestingly, that means there are situations when drawing more triangles is actually faster.

cues.zh: 我们针对小三角形做了优化，那小实例呢？
cues.en: We've optimized for tiny triangles, but how about tiny instances?

cues.zh: 当整个网格只覆盖几个像素时会发生什么？
cues.en: What happens when an entire mesh only covers a few pixels?

cues.zh: 簇层级只能做到一定程度。
cues.en: The cluster hierarchy only goes so far.

cues.zh: 它终止于一个包含 128 个三角形的根簇。
cues.en: It ends at one root cluster of 128 triangles.

cues.zh: 到那时，开销就不再随分辨率扩展了。
cues.en: At that point, cost stops scaling with resolution.

cues.zh: 这完全无法继续扩展了。
cues.en: It stops scaling altogether.

cues.zh: 但那真的非常小。
cues.en: That's really small though.

cues.zh: 我们可以在实例变得很小时直接剔除它们。
cues.en: We could just cull instances when they get tiny.

cues.zh: 但如果它们是结构性构件就不行，比如从极远处看到的一栋建筑的墙体部分。
cues.en: Except not if they're structural building blocks, say a wall section of a building seen from very far away.

cues.zh: 剔除小实例可能导致整栋建筑消失。
cues.en: Culling small instances could mean entire buildings vanish.

cues.zh: 这种情况多久发生一次？
cues.en: How often does this happen?

cues.zh: 这甚至值得处理吗？
cues.en: Is it even worth addressing?

cues.zh: 自从用上 Nanite，我们的美术把实例数量推得和多边形数量一样高，甚至更高。
cues.en: Since getting their hands on Nanite, our artists have pushed instance count just as much, if not more so than poly count.

cues.zh: 办公室里的笑话是：实例就是新的三角形。
cues.en: Joke around the office is instances are the new triangles.

cues.zh: 这给许多我们计划改进的环节带来了压力，但微小实例绝对是个问题。
cues.en: This stresses numerous things we plan to improve, but tiny instances were absolutely a problem.

cues.zh: 我们最终需要合并。
cues.en: We will need to merge eventually.

cues.zh: 显然，远处的地块在某个阶段需要流式切换为更廉价的代理。
cues.en: Obviously distant lands need to stream out to a cheaper proxy at some point.

cues.zh: 即使我们能让实例的渲染开销完美地按比例缩放，用于存储它们的内存也无法做到。
cues.en: Even if we could make the rendering cost for instances scale perfectly, the memory to store them won't.

cues.zh: 光是变换数据本身，到某个规模就会变得过于庞大。
cues.en: Just the transforms themselves will become too much at some point.

cues.zh: 我们希望未来能支持分层实例化来改变这个局面，但它并不适用于所有情况。
cues.en: We hope to support hierarchical instancing in the future to change this equation, but it doesn't apply to all cases.

cues.zh: 我们需要在远处做通用合并，但那就意味着数据不再是唯一的。
cues.en: We need general-purpose merging in the distance, but that means unique data.

cues.zh: 而高分辨率的唯一数据很快就会失控。
cues.en: And high resolution unique data gets out of control really fast.

cues.zh: 我们不希望在世界尺度上受到巨型纹理或巨型几何体之类的限制。
cues.en: We don't want mega texture or mega geometry sort of limitations on world scale.

cues.zh: 理想情况下，几何体是像素级精确的，在远处也没有感知上的损失。
cues.en: Ideally geometry is pixel perfect with no perceptual loss at distance.

cues.zh: 所以合并代理需要尽可能往远处推，而在此之前我们需要一个解决方案。
cues.en: So merge proxies need to be pushed as far away as possible and we need a solution before that.

cues.zh: 我们目前对此的解决方案是可见性缓冲区 impostor。
cues.en: Our current solution to that is visibility buffer imposters.

cues.zh: 这就是最基础的静态 imposter，只做了一点小改动。
cues.en: This is your basic static imposters with a small tweak.

cues.zh: 也就是不存储颜色或 G buffer 属性。
cues.en: That you don't store color or G buffer attributes.

cues.zh: 它们存储来自根簇的深度和三角形 ID。
cues.en: They store depth and triangle ID from the root cluster.

cues.zh: 这些数据可以直接注入屏幕的可见性缓冲区，并支持材质重映射、非均匀缩放，以及 Nanite 支持的其他功能。
cues.en: That can be directly injected into the screen's visibility buffer and supports remapping materials, non-uniform scale and anything else Nanite supports.

cues.zh: 某些情况下确实能看出画质损失，所以切换过去时有时会表现为一次跳变。
cues.en: There's definitely a quality loss that can be noticed in some cases, meaning switching to it can sometimes be noticed as a pop.

cues.zh: 通常只有在许多相同 mesh 彼此相邻时才会这样，比如重复的墙面段；切换之所以明显，是因为发生了批量变化，而且旁边就有可直接对比的对象。
cues.en: Usually this only happens when many of the same mesh are next to one another like repeating wall sections and the switch is noticeable because there is a bulk change and a directly neighboring thing to compare it to.

cues.zh: 不过大多数时候效果都挺不错。
cues.en: Most of the time it works pretty well, though.

cues.zh: 我很想把它换成同样快、但占用内存更少、而且真正无缝的方案。
cues.en: I would love to replace this with something that is just as fast, but consumes less memory and is truly seamless.

cues.zh: 接下来讲材质。
cues.en: Let's move on to materials.

cues.zh: 这和之前讲的一样，只是相对 Nanite 展开得更细。
cues.en: This is the same thing we covered before but with more detail relative to Nanite.

cues.zh: 解码可见性缓冲区后，我们基本就拥有了像素着色器正常执行所需的全部内容。
cues.en: After decoding the visibility buffer, we basically have everything a pixel shader normally has to execute.

cues.zh: 所以我们可以画一个覆盖屏幕的四边形，解码可见性缓冲区，然后求值材质像素着色器，几乎就像它是在光栅化期间绑定的一样。
cues.en: So we could draw a quad covering the screen, decode the vis buffer and evaluate the material pixel shader almost like it was bound during rasterization.

cues.zh: 在 Nanite 中，顶点变换可能是固定功能，但我们想支持完全由美术创建的像素着色器。
cues.en: Vertex transform might be fixed function in Nanite, but we want to support full artist-created pixel shaders.

cues.zh: 所以我们不希望对所有像素只用一个材质。
cues.en: So we don't want just one material for all pixels.

cues.zh: 我们怎么知道这个像素是什么材质？
cues.en: How do we know what material this pixel has?

cues.zh: 我们也可以从可见性缓冲区里推导出来。
cues.en: We can derive that from the vis buffer too.

cues.zh: 有了可调用着色器，理论上我们就能用这种方式在单次 pass 中应用所有材质，但这里面既有复杂性，也有低效之处。
cues.en: With callable shaders we could in theory apply all materials in a single pass this way, but there are complexities and inefficiencies there.

cues.zh: 取而代之，我们可以为每个唯一材质绘制一个全屏四边形，并跳过材质 ID 与该材质不匹配的像素。
cues.en: Instead, we could draw a full screen quad per unique material and skip the material the pixels not matching this material ID.

cues.zh: 不幸的是，由于所有调用都由 GPU 驱动，CPU 并不知道哪些材质可见。
cues.en: Unfortunately, because all calling is GPU driven, the CPU isn't aware of what materials are visible.

cues.zh: 材质的绘制调用无论如何都必须发出。
cues.en: Material draw calls have to be issued regardless.

cues.zh: 为每个材质测试每个像素会非常低效。
cues.en: It would be awfully inefficient to test every pixel for every material.

cues.zh: 有硬件可以剔除大量像素，并高效地把幸存像素按波次打包。
cues.en: There's hardware to cull tons of pixels and efficiently pack the surviving pixels in waves.

cues.zh: 模板测试听起来最接近，但我们不想为每个材质都重置测试。
cues.en: Stencil sounds like the closest, but we don't want to reset the test for every material.

cues.zh: 相反，我们利用深度测试硬件。
cues.en: Instead, we exploit the depth test hardware.

cues.zh: 材质 ID 会成为深度值。
cues.en: Material ID becomes the depth value.

cues.zh: 在主机上，我们可以对内存做别名处理并已知布局，从而让这件事更高效：一个计算着色器同时输出材质深度和标准深度，供后续渲染通道使用。
cues.en: On console, we can alias memory and know the layouts, such that we can make this efficient, a compute shader outputs both material depth and standard depth that we use in later passes.

cues.zh: 除了深度缓冲区，它还会输出 H tile，这样我们就能获得高 Z 加速。
cues.en: Along with depth buffers, it also outputs H tile, so we can get high Z acceleration.

cues.zh: 因此对于所有材质，我们绘制一个全屏四边形，其中四边形的 Z 值就是材质深度，深度测试设为 equals，这样只绘制 ID 匹配的像素。
cues.en: So for all materials, we draw a full-screen quad where the quad Z value is the material depth and the depth test is set to equals so that we only draw pixels with matching ID.

cues.zh: 不过，大多数材质只覆盖屏幕的一小部分。
cues.en: Most materials only cover a small fraction of the screen, though.

cues.zh: High Z 剔除在粗粒度剔除上做得相当好，但我们还能做得更好。
cues.en: High Z cull culling does a pretty good job of coarse culling, but we can do better.

cues.zh: 我们不再绘制全屏四边形，不再绘制全屏四边形，而是绘制一个 tile 网格，其中的 tile 会根据 32 位掩码进行剔除；该掩码是在构建材质深度时生成的。
cues.en: Instead of a full-screen quad, instead of a full-screen quad, we draw a grid of tiles where the tiles are culled according to a 32-bit mask that was built when material depth was.

cues.zh: 这部分目前正在大幅重构，未来很可能会完全转向 compute。
cues.en: This is an area that is being heavily reworked now and we'll likely switch completely to compute in the future.

cues.zh: 我讲的内容说明了 council path 在我们展示的两个 demo 中是如何工作的。
cues.en: What I've explained discusses how the council path works for the two demos that we've shown.

cues.zh: 由于材质仍是连贯的像素着色器，我们仍可使用基于有限差分的导数来做纹理过滤。
cues.en: Because materials are still coherent pixel shaders, we still have finite difference-based derivatives to use for texture filtering.

cues.zh: 与传统光栅化不同，像素四边形会跨越三角形分布。
cues.en: Unlike traditional rasterization, the pixel quads span across triangles.

cues.zh: 这是好事，因为对于很小的三角形，quad overdraw 很快就会失控。
cues.en: This is a very good thing because tiny triangles with tiny triangles, quad overdraw can get out of hand very quickly.

cues.zh: 但四边形也会跨越深度不连续处、UV 接缝，甚至不同物体，这就不妙了。
cues.en: But quads also span depth discontinuities, UV seams and even different objects, and that is not good.

cues.zh: 对不连续处做有限差分毫无意义，而且结果往往巨大，导致选用过高的 MIP 层级，产生像这张图里的伪影。
cues.en: Finite differences of discontinuities are nonsense, and often huge, which result in high MIP levels being used like the artifacts in this image.

cues.zh: 相反，我们会计算属性在三角形上的解析导数。
cues.en: Instead, we compute analytic derivatives of the attributes across the triangle.

cues.zh: 这些导数会利用链式法则，自动通过美术创建的节点图传播。
cues.en: These are propagated through the artist-created node node graphs automatically using the chain rule.

cues.zh: 如果遇到无法解析求导的操作，我们就回退到有限差分。
cues.en: If we encounter an operation that isn't analytically differentiable, we fall back on finite differences.

cues.zh: 我们也可以改用射线微分之类的方法来保证正确，但到目前为止还没遇到问题。
cues.en: We could, instead, resort to something like ray differentials to be correct, but we haven't had issues so far.

cues.zh: 所有采样调用都会替换为使用我们梯度的 sample grad。
cues.en: All sample calls are replaced with sample grad using our gradients.

cues.zh: 这一切看起来会带来显著开销，但我们测得，对于我们的材质，额外开销不到 2%。
cues.en: All this would appear to add a significant cost, but we've measured the overhead at less than 2% for our materials.

cues.zh: 开销之所以很小，是因为额外工作只发生在影响纹理采样的操作上，而且我们所有的虚拟纹理采样已经使用 sample grad 来处理瓦片不连续。
cues.en: The reason this is small is the additional work is only for operations affecting texture sampling and all of our virtual texture samples already use sample grad to handle the tile discontinuities.

cues.zh: 我们已经完整讲完主视图从开始到结束的整个渲染管线。
cues.en: We've now covered the entire rendering pipeline from start to finish for the primary view.

cues.zh: 下面来看每个阶段大致会经过哪些数据量。
cues.en: Here's a look at the sort of numbers that go through each stage.

cues.zh: 如果用 UE4 的标准渲染路径渲染这一帧，光栅化会超过十亿个三角形。
cues.en: If we rendered this frame using the standard rendering path in UE4, it would rasterize over a billion triangles.

cues.zh: 而 Nanite 凭借智能 LOD 和剔除，只光栅化 2500 万个三角形。
cues.en: Nanite on the other hand rasterizes 25 million triangles due to its intelligent lodding and culling.

cues.zh: 无论场景多复杂，整个演示过程中这 2500 万都保持一致。
cues.en: That 25 million is consistent throughout the demo, regardless of how complex the scene is.

cues.zh: 而且这一切都做得非常快。
cues.en: And it does it all really fast.

cues.zh: 本次演示中，我们使用动态分辨率和时域上采样到 4K。
cues.en: We use dynamic resolution and temporal upsampling to 4k for this demo.

cues.zh: 上采样前平均帧分辨率约为 1400p。
cues.en: The average frame hovers at about 1400p before upsample.

cues.zh: 所有几何剔除和光栅化——从 GPU scene 和 view 开始，到生成完整光栅化的 vis buffer——平均耗时 2.5 毫秒。
cues.en: All geometry culling and rasterization, starting from the GPU scene and view to the complete rasterized vis buffer, takes on average 2.5 milliseconds.

cues.zh: 因为这一切都由 GPU 驱动，CPU 开销可以忽略不计。
cues.en: Because this is all GPU driven, there is a negligible CPU cost.

cues.zh: 应用材质并将 vis buffer 转换为 G buffer，平均需要 2 毫秒。
cues.en: To apply the materials and transform the vis buffer to the G buffer, takes on average 2 milliseconds.

cues.zh: 这会带来少量 CPU 开销，每个材质一次绘制。
cues.en: This has a small CPU cost with one draw per material.

cues.zh: 完全在 60 Hz 游戏的预算之内。
cues.en: Well within budget for a 60 Hz game.

cues.zh: 主视图并不是我们唯一需要绘制几何体的地方，我们还需要阴影。
cues.en: Primary view isn't the only place we need to draw geometry, we need shadows too.

cues.zh: 次级视图真的需要微多边形级别的细节吗？
cues.en: Do we really need micropoly level detail for secondary views?

cues.zh: 间接光照也许不需要，但阴影需要细节。
cues.en: Maybe not for indirect lighting, but shadows need detail.

cues.zh: 事实上，真实几何体与法线贴图之间最大的视觉差异，往往来自精细的自阴影。
cues.en: In fact, the largest visual difference between real geometry and normal maps often comes from detailed self shadowing.

cues.zh: 我们能对阴影进行光线追踪吗？
cues.en: Can we ray trace them?

cues.zh: 不幸的是，阴影光线比主光线更多，因为平均每个像素有不止一个光源。
cues.en: Unfortunately, there are more shadow rays than primary, since there is on average more than one light per pixel.

cues.zh: 我们需要至少和主通道一样快的方案。
cues.en: We need something at least as fast as what we have for primary.

cues.zh: 即使追踪速度够快，硬件光线追踪 API 目前也不够灵活，无法在不大幅膨胀内存的前提下评估我们复杂的 LOD 逻辑，以适配它们特定的三角形格式。
cues.en: Even if tracing was fast enough, hardware ray tracing APIs aren't currently flexible enough to evaluate our complex LOD logic to not massively bloat memory to conform to their specific triangle format.

cues.zh: 而且它们无法局部更新 BVH，以避免代价高昂的、从零构建百万级元素 BVH。
cues.en: And they lack the ability to partially update BVHs to avoid expensive from scratch million element BVH builds.

cues.zh: 未来我们会进一步研究 Nanite 的光线追踪，但目前我们想要一个光栅化方案，来利用我们其他所有工作。
cues.en: We'll be looking more into ray tracing Nanite in the future, but for now we want a raster solution to leverage all of our other work.

cues.zh: 每个像素的光源数量确实需要认真对待。
cues.en: That number of lights per pixel really needs to be taken seriously.

cues.zh: 非常重要的一点是，Nanite 的开销不会因为阴影而成倍失控。
cues.en: It is very important that Nanite's cost don't multiply out of control due to shadows.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，大多数光源以及由它们投射阴影的大多数几何体都不会移动。
cues.en: Thankfully, most lights and most geometry casting shadows from them don't move.

cues.zh: 如果能把这些工作缓存起来，就有机会把它控制在可承受范围内。
cues.en: If we can cache this work, there's a chance that we can keep this under control.

cues.zh: Nanite 支持常规的阴影贴图绘制，但这一新架构让一些此前不实用的新技术成为可能。
cues.en: Nanite supports normal shadow map drawing, but this new architecture enables new techniques that weren't practical before.

cues.zh: 它让我们得以实现高效的虚拟阴影贴图。
cues.en: It allowed us to implement efficient virtual shadow maps.

cues.zh: 现在我们所有场景都用 16k 阴影贴图。
cues.en: We use 16k shadow maps for everything now.

cues.zh: 根据光源不同，可能有一张或多张阴影贴图。
cues.en: Depending on the light, there might be one or more shadow maps.

cues.zh: 我们光栅化到阴影贴图中的分辨率，会与这些三角形投射到屏幕上所占的像素相匹配。
cues.en: The the resolution that we rasterize into the shadow map is made to match the screen pixels that those triangles cast onto.

cues.zh: 如果阴影贴图的那个区域没有投射到屏幕上的任何东西，我们就不绘制它。
cues.en: If that region of the shadow map doesn't cast onto anything on screen, we don't draw it.

cues.zh: 与更常见的阴影渲染优化方法相比，我们不仅省去了光栅化工作，甚至不会为那些我们根本不会采样的阴影贴图空间分配内存。
cues.en: Compared to more common approaches to optimize shadow rendering, not only are we calling the rasterization work, we don't even allocate memory to shadow map space that we aren't going to sample.

cues.zh: 这些 16k 阴影贴图是虚拟化且稀疏的。
cues.en: These 16k shadow maps are virtualized and sparse.

cues.zh: 页大小是 128，所以 MIP 0 是 128×128 个页。
cues.en: Page size is 128, so MIP 0 is 128 by 128 pages.

cues.zh: 每帧分配虚拟内存相当简单直接。
cues.en: Allocation of the virtual memory every frame is fairly straightforward.

cues.zh: 对屏幕上的每个像素，对所有影响该像素的光源，将位置投影到阴影贴图空间。
cues.en: For each pixel on screen, for all of the lights affecting this pixel, project the position into shadow map space.

cues.zh: 选择一个 MIP 级别，使一个纹素匹配一个屏幕像素的大小，并在该级别中按需将该页标记为需要。
cues.en: Pick the MIP level where one texel matches the size of one screen pixel, mark that page in that level as needed.

cues.zh: 我们也支持缓存，因此会避免在阴影贴图中重绘上一帧已经覆盖过的区域。
cues.en: We support caching too, so we avoid drawing anywhere in the shadow map that we that we've already covered in a previous frame.

cues.zh: 这意味着大多数情况下，每帧更新的阴影贴图区域只包括物体移动的区域，以及相机移动时的视锥边缘。
cues.en: This means for the most part on the only regions of the shadow maps that are updated each frame are those where objects are moving or edges of the frustum as the camera moves.

cues.zh: 尽管我们支持所有网格渲染到虚拟阴影贴图中，但与 Nanite 结合时才是它真正出彩的地方。
cues.en: Although we support all meshes rendering into virtual shadow maps, combined with Nanite is really where it shines.

cues.zh: 但首先，我们需要对 Nanite 渲染做一些修改，让它更高效。
cues.en: But first we need to make some modifications to Nanite rendering to make it efficient.

cues.zh: Nanite 管线其实相当深，同步开销也很大。
cues.en: The Nanite pipeline is actually fairly deep with significant synchronization overhead.

cues.zh: 与全分辨率主视图的成本相比，这很小。
cues.en: That's tiny, compared to the proportional to the cost of a full resolution primary view.

cues.zh: 但为了少量工作而启动整个管线，可能非常低效。
cues.en: But spinning up the pipeline for a minor amount of work can be very inefficient.

cues.zh: 所以，我们不想多次调用 Nanite 渲染，比如每盏灯调用一次，更糟的是每盏灯的每个阴影贴图的每个 MIP 层级都调用一次。
cues.en: So we don't want to call Nanite render many times, like once for each light or worse, for each MIP level for each shadow map for each light.

cues.zh: 于是我们给 Nanite 加了多视图支持。
cues.en: Instead we added multi-view support to Nanite.

cues.zh: Nanite 管线拿到的是一个要渲染的视图数组，而不只是一个视图。
cues.en: The Nanite pipeline gets an array of views to render instead of just one.

cues.zh: 现在，Nanite 不仅能通过一条由相互依赖的间接调度组成的链绘制整个场景，还能一次性把场景中每盏灯的所有阴影贴图渲染到它们各自所有的虚拟化 MIP 层级。
cues.en: Now, not only can Nanite draw the entire scene with a single chain of dependent dispatch indirects, it can render all shadow maps for every light in the scene to all of their virtualized MIP maps at once.

cues.zh: 在极端情况下，相比逐个调用，我们见过 100 倍的提速。
cues.en: In extreme cases, we've seen 100x speed up compared to individual calls.

cues.zh: 为了剔除会绘制到阴影贴图未映射区域的工作，我们在通常用包围矩形对 HCB 做测试的位置旁边，额外插入一项测试。
cues.en: To call work that would draw to unmapped regions of the shadow map, we slot in an extra test next to where we normally test the bounding wrecht against the HCB.

cues.zh: 对于阴影，它还会针对所需页面掩码进行测试。
cues.en: For shadows, it also tests against the needed pages mask.

cues.zh: 如果某个实例或簇与所需页面没有重叠，就会被剔除。
cues.en: If an instance or cluster doesn't overlap a needed page, it is culled.

cues.zh: 我们写入的物理纹理在虚拟空间中并不连续。
cues.en: The physical texture we are writing to isn't contiguous in virtual space.

cues.zh: 这意味着跨越多个页面的簇不能指望像素寻址是直接寻址。
cues.en: This means clusters that overlap multiple pages can't expect the addressing of the pixel to be direct.

cues.zh: 我们有多种方法来处理这一点。
cues.en: We have multiple approaches to handle that.

cues.zh: 对于软件光栅化器，最好让内层循环尽可能简单。
cues.en: For the software rasterizer, it is best to keep the inner loop as simple as possible.

cues.zh: 我们发现，内层循环中哪怕只多一次移位，也能测出性能影响。
cues.en: We found even a single additional shift in the inner loop is measurable.

cues.zh: 所以改为：对每个重叠页，向光栅化器提交一个可见簇，为该簇做一次页转换，并裁剪到该页像素。
cues.en: So instead we emit one visible cluster to the rasterizer per overlapped page, do the page translation once for the cluster, and scissor to the page pixels.

cues.zh: 软件簇很小，所以大多数只与单个页重叠。
cues.en: Software clusters are small, so most overlap a single page.

cues.zh: 硬件簇更大。
cues.en: Hardware clusters are bigger.

cues.zh: 常会重叠多个页，复制顶点和三角形开销并不划算。
cues.en: Often overlap multiple pages and duplicating the vertex and triangle cost doesn't make sense.

cues.zh: 因此改为逐像素进行虚拟页到物理页的页表转换。
cues.en: Instead, we do the virtual to physical page table translation per pixel.

cues.zh: 由于我们做的是原子 UAV 写入，即使在硬件路径中，也可以自由地分散写入。
cues.en: Because we are doing atomic UAV writes, even in the hardware path, we are free to scatter them.

cues.zh: Nanite 的细粒度调用对高效虚拟阴影贴图帮助很大，LOD 也是如此。
cues.en: Nanite's fine-grained calling is hugely helpful for efficient virtual shadow maps, but so is the level of detail.

cues.zh: 与主视图一样，Nanite 会选择匹配一个像素误差的 LOD。
cues.en: Just like in the primary view, Nanite picks the LOD matching one pixel error.

cues.zh: 对阴影来说，这意味着它正在光栅化到的 mip 层级的像素。
cues.en: In the case of shadows, this means the pixels of the mip level it is rasterizing to.

cues.zh: 记住，选择 MIP 层级时要让一个纹素对应一个像素。
cues.en: And remember that the mip level was chosen such that one texel equals one pixel.

cues.zh: 这样能保持开销大致随屏幕分辨率缩放，而不是随场景复杂度缩放。
cues.en: This maintains the property of roughly scaling cost with screen resolution, not scene complexity.

cues.zh: 这并不意味着绘制到阴影贴图中的三角形与主视图绘制的三角形完全相同。
cues.en: That does not mean that the triangles drawn to the shadow map are exactly the same as those drawn in the primary view.

cues.zh: 这种不一致会导致错误的自阴影；我们用一小段屏幕空间追踪来覆盖两者可能不同的区域，从而处理这一差异。
cues.en: That mismatch can cause incorrect self-shadowing and we address that discrepancy with a short screen-space trace to span the zone where they can differ.

cues.zh: 几何体上的虚拟内存类比在概念上与虚拟纹理非常相似。
cues.en: The virtual memory analogy for geometry is conceptually very similar to virtual texturing.

cues.zh: 尽管细节不同，也存在一些独特的挑战。
cues.en: Although the details are different and there's some unique challenges.

cues.zh: 相似之处在于，GPU 在发现质量不足时会请求数据，而 CPU 则通过从磁盘加载数据来异步满足这些请求。
cues.en: It is similar in that GPU requests data where it finds the quality is insufficient and the CPU asynchro- asynchronously fulfills those requests by loading the data from disk.

cues.zh: 不同之处在于，我们加载和卸载数据时，必须确保它始终是整个 DAG 的一个有效切割。
cues.en: It is different in that we load and unload data we need to make sure that it is always a valid cut of the full DAG.

cues.zh: 那么我们流式传输什么？
cues.en: So what do we stream?

cues.zh: 最小的可流式传输单元是什么？
cues.en: What is the smallest streamable unit?

cues.zh: 记住，简化是在组级别发生的。
cues.en: Remember how simplification happens at the group level.

cues.zh: 根据构建方式，一个簇组会被它的父级精确替换。
cues.en: By construction, a cluster group is exactly replaced by its parents.

cues.zh: 反过来，父级只能由完整的一组子级替换。
cues.en: Conversely, the parents can only be replaced by a full group of children.

cues.zh: 所以，在该组中所有同级簇也加载完成之前，我们不能开始渲染某个簇，否则就不是完整替换。
cues.en: So we can't start rendering a cluster before all of its siblings in that group are also loaded, otherwise it won't be a complete replacement.

cues.zh: 因此，没有理由以比组更细的粒度进行流式传输。
cues.en: Thus there's no reason to stream at a finer than group granularity.

cues.zh: 这样做甚至可能导致渲染错误。
cues.en: Doing so could even result in incorrect rendering.

cues.zh: 与虚拟纹理相比的另一处不同是，几何体的大小是可变的，甚至在压缩之前也是如此。
cues.en: Another difference compared to virtual texturing is that geometry has variable size, even before compression.

cues.zh: 簇的顶点数量、属性数量等是可变的。
cues.en: Clusters have a variable number of vertices, attributes, and so on.

cues.zh: 为了避免内存碎片，我们希望使用固定大小的页，但这也意味着每页必须容纳数量可变的几何数据。
cues.en: To avoid memory fragmentation, we want to use fixed-size pages, but this also means we have to fit a variable amount of geometry per page.

cues.zh: 因此，我们用簇组填满固定大小的页。
cues.en: So we fill fixed-size pages with cluster groups.

cues.zh: 在决定把哪些组放到同一页时，我们同时考虑空间局部性和 DAG 中的层级。
cues.en: We account for both spatial locality and level in the DAG when deciding which groups to put on the same page.

cues.zh: 这样做是为了尽量减少运行时可能需要的页数。
cues.en: We do this to try to minimize the number of pages that are likely to be needed at runtime.

cues.zh: 第一页是根页，它始终常驻，并在容量允许的范围内包含 DAG 顶部尽可能多的内容。
cues.en: The first page, the root page, is always resident and contains as much of the top of the DAG as we can fit in a page.

cues.zh: 始终保留根页意味着无论什么情况，我们总有东西可渲染。
cues.en: Always having the root page means we always have something to render, no matter what.
