cues.zh: 常驻页存储在 GPU 上的一个大字节地址缓冲区中。
cues.en: The resident pages are stored in one big byte address buffer on the GPU.

cues.zh: 用整组来填充页面会产生大量闲置空间，因为组可能相当大。
cues.en: Unfortunately, filling pages with whole groups can result in a lot of slack, because groups can be quite large.

cues.zh: 每个组包含 8 到 32 个簇，每个簇最大约 2 KB。
cues.en: They range from 8 to 32 clusters and each cluster is up to about 2 kilobytes.

cues.zh: 我们的解决方案在概念上很简单。
cues.en: Our solution is conceptually simple.

cues.zh: 我们以簇为粒度，把组拆成多个部分。
cues.en: We split the groups into multiple parts at cluster granularity.

cues.zh: 如前所述，一个簇只有在所有同级簇都加载完成后才能绘制，因此拆分后的组只有在所有部分都加载完成后才算激活。
cues.en: Because previously mentioned a cluster cannot be drawn before all of its siblings are loaded, a split group is only considered active when all of its parts are loaded.

cues.zh: 通过以簇而非组为粒度填充页面，页面中只会产生约 1% 的浪费。
cues.en: By filling pages at cluster granularity instead of groups, we only incur around 1% waste in the pages.

cues.zh: 那么，我们如何决定加载什么？
cues.en: So how do we decide what to load?

cues.zh: 对于虚拟纹理来说，这很简单。
cues.en: For virtual texturing, this is easy.

cues.zh: 需要加载的数据可以直接根据 UV 坐标以及选定的 LOD 层级或 UV 梯度来确定。
cues.en: The data that needs to be loaded can be determined directly from the UV coordinates and the selected LOD level or UV gradient.

cues.zh: 对 Nanite 来说，我们无法直接根据查询位置和 LOD 误差找到数据。
cues.en: For Nanite, we can't find the data directly from the query position and LOD error.

cues.zh: 我们需要遍历层级结构来找到它。
cues.en: We need to traverse the hierarchy to find it.

cues.zh: 遍历时，我们得查看当前流式裁剪范围之外的节点，并判断它们如果已驻留是否本会被绘制。
cues.en: During traversal, we have to look at nodes beyond the current streaming cut and determine if they would have been drawn had they been resident.

cues.zh: 这意味着调用层级需要覆盖当前已流式加载内容之外的更多内容。
cues.en: This means that the calling hierarchy needs to cover more than what is currently streamed in.

cues.zh: 该层级结构很小，因为它只包含关于 cluster group 频率的元信息。
cues.en: The hierarchy is small as it only contains meta-information about cluster group frequency.

cues.zh: 所以为简单起见，我们始终让层级结构完全驻留。
cues.en: So for simplicity, we always keep the hierarchy fully resident.

cues.zh: 还有个额外好处：遍历独立于当前流式裁剪，并且能越过它深入好几层。
cues.en: This has the added benefit that traversal is independent from the current streaming cut and can go several levels beyond it.

cues.zh: 新对象可以立即请求达到目标质量所需的所有层级的数据。
cues.en: A new object can immediately request data from all of the levels it needs for target quality.

cues.zh: 如果层级结构本身也要流式加载，那就必须逐级进行，跨越好几帧。
cues.en: Had the hierarchy itself also then streamed, this would have to happen level by level over several frames.

cues.zh: I/O 延迟会乘以我们偏差的层级数，导致更明显的弹出。
cues.en: I/O latency would be multiplied by the number of levels we are off, which translates to more visible pop-in.

cues.zh: 在实践中，流式请求是作为层级簇剔除遍历的一部分生成的。
cues.en: In in practice, the streaming requests are generated as part of the hierarchical cluster calling traversal.

cues.zh: 一个请求包含一个页面范围，其优先级基于 LOD 误差。
cues.en: A request consists of a range of pages with a priority based on the LOD error.

cues.zh: 这些请求不仅为主视图生成，也会为任何活动的阴影视图生成，不过后者优先级更低。
cues.en: They are generated not only for the primary view, but also any active shadow views, although those are considered lower priority.

cues.zh: 还值得注意的是，即使页面已驻留，也会发出请求以更新其优先级。
cues.en: It is also worth noting that the requests are emitted even for resident pages to update their priorities.

cues.zh: 这些请求由 CPU 异步回读。
cues.en: The requests are read back asynchronously by the CPU.

cues.zh: 它会补上缺失的 DAG 依赖，并为最高优先级的页面发出 I/O 请求。
cues.en: It adds any missing DAG dependencies and issues I/O requests for the highest priority pages.

cues.zh: 最后，当 I/O 请求就绪后，页面数据会被装载到 GPU，并更新 GPU 端的数据结构。
cues.en: Finally, when the I/O requests are ready, the page data is installed on the GPU, and the GPU-side data structures are updated.

cues.zh: 这包括修正已加载或已卸载页面的指针，修正已完成或不再完整的拆分组的指针，还涉及将簇标记为叶节点或取消叶节点标记。
cues.en: This includes fixing up pointers for loaded or unloaded pages, fixing pointers for split groups that have been completed or are no longer complete, and involves marking and unmarking clusters as leaves.

cues.zh: 我要讲的最后一个主题是压缩。
cues.en: The last topic I'll talk about is compression.

cues.zh: 对于 Nanite，我们实际上有两种压缩几何体格式。
cues.en: For Nanite, we actually have two compressed geometry formats.

cues.zh: 它们表示相同的数据，但针对不同目标进行了优化。
cues.en: They represent the same data, but are optimized for different goals.

cues.zh: 内存表示是渲染代码在光栅化和延迟材质阶段直接使用的形式。
cues.en: The memory representation is what is used directly by the rendering code during rasterization and for the deferred material passes.

cues.zh: 这要求解码和随机访问近乎即时，因为任意三角形都可能通过可见性缓冲区查找来请求。
cues.en: This needs to be near instant to decode and random access as any triangle can be requested from a visibility buffer lookup.

cues.zh: 这里的目标是压低流式加载池所需的内存。
cues.en: The goal here is to keep the memory required for the streaming pool down.

cues.zh: 就算有内存可挥霍，缓存里装更多数据也意味着更少缓存未命中，从而减少 IO 和物体突然弹出的机会。
cues.en: Even if we had the memory to burn, fitting more data in the cache means less cache misses, which means less IO and chance for pop-in.

cues.zh: 光是变换本身，到某个时候也会变得太多。
cues.en: Just the transforms themselves will become too much at some point.

cues.zh: 我们希望未来支持分层实例化来改变这个局面，但它并不适用于所有情况。
cues.en: We hope to support hierarchical instancing in the future to change this equation, but it doesn't apply to all cases.

cues.zh: 我们需要远距离的通用合并，但这意味着独特数据和高分辨率独特数据会很快失控。
cues.en: We need general-purpose merging in the distance, but that means unique data and high resolution unique data gets out of control really fast.

cues.zh: 我们不希望在世界尺度上受 MegaTexture 或巨型几何体之类的限制。
cues.en: We don't want mega texture or mega geometry sort of limitations on world scale.

cues.zh: 理想情况下，几何体是像素级精确的，在远处也没有感知损失。
cues.en: Ideally geometry is pixel-perfect with no perceptual loss at distance.

cues.zh: 所以合并代理得尽可能推远，而我们需要在那之前拿出解决方案。
cues.en: So merge proxies need to be pushed as far away as possible and we need a solution before that.

cues.zh: 我们目前的解决方案是可见性缓冲区 impostor。
cues.en: Our current solution to that is visibility buffer imposters.

cues.zh: 这是基础的静态 impostor，只做了一点小改动。
cues.en: This is your basic static imposters with a small tweak.

cues.zh: 它不存储颜色或 G-buffer 属性。
cues.en: That you don't store color or G buffer attributes.

cues.zh: 它们存储来自根簇的深度和三角形 ID。
cues.en: They store depth and triangle ID from the root cluster.

cues.zh: 这可以直接注入屏幕的可见性缓冲区，并支持材质重映射、非均匀缩放以及 Nanite 支持的其他功能。
cues.en: That can be directly injected into the screen's visibility buffer and supports remapping materials, non-uniform scale and anything else Nanite supports.

cues.zh: 某些情况下确实能注意到质量损失，也就是说切换到它时有时会看到跳变。
cues.en: There's definitely a quality loss that can be noticed in some cases, meaning switching to it can sometimes be noticed as a pop.

cues.zh: 通常只有在许多相同网格相邻时才会出现，比如重复的墙体段；切换之所以明显，是因为发生了大面积变化，而且旁边就有可直接对比的对象。
cues.en: Usually this only happens when many of the same mesh are next to one another like repeating wall sections and the switch is noticeable because there is a bulk change and a directly neighboring thing to compare it to.

cues.zh: 不过大多数时候，它运行得相当不错。
cues.en: Most of the time it works pretty well though.

cues.zh: 我很想用这样的方案替换它：速度一样快，但占用内存更少，而且真正无缝。
cues.en: I would love to replace this with something that is just as fast, but consumes less memory and is truly seamless.

cues.zh: 接下来讲材质。
cues.en: Let's move on to materials.

cues.zh: 这和之前讲过的是同一件事，不过会结合 Nanite 讲得更细。
cues.en: This is the same thing we covered before, but with more detail relative to Nanite.

cues.zh: 解码可见性缓冲区后，我们基本上就具备了像素着色器通常执行所需的一切。
cues.en: After decoding the visibility buffer, we basically have everything a pixel shader normally has to execute.

cues.zh: 因此我们可以绘制一个覆盖屏幕的四边形，解码可见性缓冲区，并执行材质像素着色器，几乎就像它在光栅化期间被绑定一样。
cues.en: So we could draw a quad covering the screen, decode the vis buffer and evaluate the material pixel shader almost like it was bound during rasterization.

cues.zh: 在 Nanite 中，顶点变换可能属于固定功能，但我们希望支持美术创建的完整像素着色器。
cues.en: Vertex transform might be fixed function in Nanite, but we want to support full artist-created pixel shaders.

cues.zh: 所以我们不希望所有像素都只用同一种材质。
cues.en: So we don't want just one material for all pixels.

cues.zh: 那我们怎么知道这个像素用的是什么材质？
cues.en: How do we know what material this pixel has?

cues.zh: 我们也可以从 vis buffer 推导出这一点。
cues.en: We can derive that from the vis buffer too.

cues.zh: 用可调用着色器，理论上我们可以这样在单个 pass 里应用所有材质，但这其中有复杂性和低效之处。
cues.en: With callable shaders we could in theory apply all materials in a single pass this way, but there are complexities and inefficiencies there.

cues.zh: 取而代之，我们可以为每个唯一材质绘制一个全屏四边形，并跳过与该材质 ID 不匹配的像素。
cues.en: Instead, we could draw a full screen quad per unique material and skip the material the pixels not matching this material ID.

cues.zh: 不幸的是，因为所有调用都是 GPU 驱动的，CPU 并不知道哪些材质可见。
cues.en: Unfortunately, because all calling is GPU driven, the CPU isn't aware of what materials are visible.

cues.zh: 无论如何都必须发出材质绘制调用。
cues.en: Material draw calls have to be issued regardless.

cues.zh: 为每个材质测试每个像素会极其低效。
cues.en: It would be awfully inefficient to test every pixel for every material.

cues.zh: 有硬件可以剔除大量像素，并把存活像素高效地按波次打包。
cues.en: There's hardware to cull tons of pixels and efficiently pack the surviving pixels in waves.

cues.zh: 模板测试听起来最接近，但我们不想为每个材质都重置测试。
cues.en: Stencil sounds like the closest, but we don't want to reset the test for every material.

cues.zh: 而是改为利用深度测试硬件。
cues.en: Instead, we exploit the depth test hardware.

cues.zh: 材质 ID 会成为深度值。
cues.en: Material ID becomes the depth value.

cues.zh: 在主机上，我们可以对内存做别名复用，并且清楚内存布局，从而让这一过程高效。
cues.en: On console, we can alias memory and know the layouts, such that we can make this efficient.

cues.zh: 计算着色器会输出材质深度和标准深度，供后续通道使用。
cues.en: A compute shader outputs both material depth and standard depth that we use in later passes.

cues.zh: 除了深度缓冲区，它还会输出 H tile，这样就能获得高 Z 加速。
cues.en: Along with depth buffers, it also outputs H tile, so we can get high Z acceleration.

cues.zh: 因此，对所有材质，我们绘制一个全屏四边形，其中四边形的 Z 值就是材质深度，深度测试设为“等于”，这样只绘制 ID 匹配的像素。
cues.en: So for all materials, we draw a full-screen quad where the quad Z value is the material depth and the depth test is set to equals so that we only draw pixels with matching ID.

cues.zh: 不过，大多数材质只覆盖屏幕的一小部分。
cues.en: Most materials only cover a small fraction of the screen, though.

cues.zh: High Z 调用剔除在粗粒度剔除上效果相当好，但我们还能做得更好。
cues.en: High Z call culling does a pretty good job of coarse culling, but we can do better.

cues.zh: 我们不再绘制全屏四边形，而是绘制瓦片网格，其中的瓦片会根据生成材质深度时构建的 32 位掩码进行剔除。
cues.en: Instead of a full-screen quad, instead of a full-screen quad, we draw a grid of tiles where the tiles are culled according to a 32-bit mask that was built when material depth was.

cues.zh: 这个领域目前正在被大幅重构，未来我们很可能会完全转向 compute。
cues.en: This is an area that is being heavily reworked now and we'll likely switch completely to compute in the future.

cues.zh: 我刚才解释的内容，说明了 council path 在我们展示的两个 demo 中是如何工作的。
cues.en: What I've explained discussed describes how the council path works for the two demos that we've shown.

cues.zh: 因为材质仍然是由连贯的像素着色器实现的，我们仍然可以使用基于有限差分的导数来进行纹理过滤。
cues.en: Because materials are still coherent pixel shaders, we still have finite difference-based derivatives to use for texture filtering.

cues.zh: 与传统光栅化不同，像素四边形会跨越三角形。
cues.en: Unlike traditional rasterization, the pixel quads span across triangles.

cues.zh: 这是件好事，因为面对微小三角形时，四边形过度绘制会很快失控。
cues.en: This is a very good thing because tiny triangles with tiny triangles, quad overdraw can get out of hand very quickly.

cues.zh: 但四边形也会跨越深度不连续处、UV 接缝，甚至不同对象，这就不妙了。
cues.en: But quads also span depth discontinuities, UV seams and even different objects, and that is not good.

cues.zh: 对不连续处做有限差分没有意义，而且结果往往很大，会导致使用过高的 MIP 层级，产生如图中的伪影。
cues.en: Finite differences of discontinuities are nonsense, and often huge, which result in high MIP levels being used like the artifacts in this image.

cues.zh: 相反，我们计算三角形上各属性的解析导数。
cues.en: Instead, we compute analytic derivatives of the attributes across the triangle.

cues.zh: 这些导数会通过链式法则，在美术创建的节点图中自动传播。
cues.en: These are propagated through the artist-created node node graphs automatically using the chain rule.

cues.zh: 如果遇到无法解析求导的运算，我们就回退到有限差分。
cues.en: If we encounter an operation that isn't analytically differentiable, we fall back on finite differences.

cues.zh: 我们也可以改用光线微分之类的方案来保证正确性，但到目前为止还没遇到问题。
cues.en: We could, instead, resort to something like ray differentials to be correct, but we haven't had issues so far.

cues.zh: 所有 sample 调用都被替换为使用我们梯度的 sample grad。
cues.en: All sample calls are replaced with sample grad using our gradients.

cues.zh: 这一切看起来会带来显著开销，但对于我们的材质，我们测得额外开销不到 2%。
cues.en: All this would appear to add a significant cost, but we've measured the overhead at less than 2% for our materials.

cues.zh: 开销之所以很小，是因为额外工作只发生在影响纹理采样的运算上，而且我们所有虚拟纹理采样已经使用 sample grad 来处理 tile 不连续。
cues.en: The reason this is small is the additional work is only for operations affecting texture sampling and all of our virtual texture samples already use sample grad to handle the tile discontinuities.

cues.zh: 我们已经从头到尾完整讲完了主视图的整个渲染管线。
cues.en: We've now covered the entire rendering pipeline from start to finish for the primary view.

cues.zh: 下面看看各个阶段所处理的数字量级。
cues.en: Here's a look at the sort of numbers that go through each stage.

cues.zh: 如果在 UE4 中用标准渲染路径渲染这一帧，它会光栅化超过十亿个三角形。
cues.en: If we rendered this frame using the standard rendering path in UE4, it would rasterize over a billion triangles.

cues.zh: 而 Nanite 依靠智能的 LOD 和剔除，只光栅化 2500 万个三角形。
cues.en: Nanite on the other hand rasterizes 25 million triangles due to its intelligent lodding and culling.

cues.zh: 这 2500 万在整个演示中保持稳定，不管场景多复杂。
cues.en: That 25 million is consistent throughout the demo, regardless of how complex the scene is.

cues.zh: 而且这一切都跑得非常快。
cues.en: And it does it all really fast.

cues.zh: 本次演示我们用了动态分辨率，再通过时域上采样到 4K。
cues.en: We use dynamic resolution and temporal upsampling to 4k for this demo.

cues.zh: 上采样前，平均分辨率大约在 1400p。
cues.en: The average frame hovers at about 1400p before upsample.

cues.zh: 从 GPU 场景和视图开始，到完成全部几何剔除与光栅化、生成完整的 vis buffer，平均只需 2.5 毫秒。
cues.en: All geometry culling and rasterization, starting from the GPU scene and view to the complete rasterized vis buffer, takes on average 2.5 milliseconds.

cues.zh: 因为这一切都由 GPU 驱动，CPU 开销可以忽略不计。
cues.en: Because this is all GPU driven, there is a negligible CPU cost.

cues.zh: 应用材质并将 vis buffer 转换为 G buffer，平均需要 2 毫秒。
cues.en: To apply the materials and transform the vis buffer to the G buffer, takes on average 2 milliseconds.

cues.zh: 每个材质一次绘制，CPU 开销很小。
cues.en: This has a small CPU cost with one draw per material.

cues.zh: 完全在 60 Hz 游戏的预算之内。
cues.en: Well within budget for a 60 Hz game.

cues.zh: 主视图并不是唯一需要绘制几何体的地方，我们还需要阴影。
cues.en: Primary view isn't the only place we need to draw geometry, we need shadows too.

cues.zh: 次级视图真的需要微多边形级别的细节吗？
cues.en: Do we really need micropoly level detail for secondary views?

cues.zh: 间接光照也许不需要，但阴影需要细节。
cues.en: Maybe not for indirect lighting, but shadows need detail.

cues.zh: 事实上，真实几何体与法线贴图之间最大的视觉差异，往往来自精细的自阴影。
cues.en: In fact, the largest visual difference between real geometry and normal maps often comes from detailed self shadowing.

cues.zh: 能对阴影做光线追踪吗？
cues.en: Can we ray trace them?

cues.zh: 不幸的是，阴影光线比主光线更多，因为平均每个像素有不止一个光源。
cues.en: Unfortunately, there are more shadow rays than primary, since there is on average more than one light per pixel.

cues.zh: 我们需要至少和现有主渲染一样快的方案。
cues.en: We need something at least as fast as what we have for primary.

cues.zh: 即使追踪足够快，硬件光追 API 目前也不够灵活，无法在符合其特定三角形格式的前提下评估我们复杂的 LOD 逻辑而不让内存大幅膨胀。
cues.en: Even if tracing was fast enough, hardware ray tracing APIs aren't currently flexible enough to evaluate our complex LOD logic to not massively bloat memory to conform to their specific triangle format.

cues.zh: 而且它们无法局部更新 BVH，以避免昂贵的从头构建百万元素 BVH。
cues.en: And they lack the ability to partially update BVHs to avoid expensive from scratch million element BVH builds.

cues.zh: 未来我们会更深入研究光线追踪 Nanite，但目前我们想要一个光栅化方案，来利用我们所有其他工作。
cues.en: We'll be looking more into ray tracing Nanite in the future, but for now we want a raster solution to leverage all of our other work.

cues.zh: 每像素那样的光源数量确实需要认真对待。
cues.en: That number of lights per pixel really needs to be taken seriously.

cues.zh: Nanite 的开销不会因阴影而失控倍增，这一点非常重要。
cues.en: It is very important that Nanite's cost don't multiply out of control due to shadows.

cues.zh: 幸运的是，大多数光源以及由其投射阴影的大多数几何体都不会移动。
cues.en: Thankfully, most lights and most geometry casting shadows from them don't move.

cues.zh: 如果能把这项工作缓存起来，我们就有机会把它控制在可控范围内。
cues.en: If we can cache this work, there's a chance that we can keep this under control.

cues.zh: Nanite 支持常规的阴影贴图绘制，但这种新架构启用了一些此前不实用的新技术。
cues.en: Nanite supports normal shadow map drawing, but this new architecture enables new techniques that weren't practical before.

cues.zh: 它让我们得以实现高效的虚拟阴影贴图。
cues.en: It allowed us to implement efficient virtual shadow maps.

cues.zh: 现在我们所有内容都使用 16k 阴影贴图。
cues.en: We use 16k shadow maps for everything now.

cues.zh: 视光源而定，可能会有一张或多张阴影贴图。
cues.en: Depending on the light, there might be one or more shadow maps.

cues.zh: 我们把三角形光栅化到阴影贴图时，分辨率会与这些三角形投射到屏幕上的像素相匹配。
cues.en: The the resolution that we rasterize into the shadow map is made to match the screen pixels that those triangles cast onto.

cues.zh: 如果阴影贴图中的那块区域不会投射到屏幕上的任何东西上，我们就不绘制它。
cues.en: If that region of the shadow map doesn't cast onto anything on screen, we don't draw it.

cues.zh: 与更常见的阴影渲染优化方法相比，我们不仅剔除了光栅化工作，甚至不会为不会采样的阴影贴图空间分配内存。
cues.en: Compared to more common approaches to optimize shadow rendering, not only are we calling the rasterization work, we don't even allocate memory to shadow map space that we aren't going to sample.

cues.zh: 这些 16K 阴影贴图是虚拟化且稀疏的。
cues.en: These 16k shadow maps are virtualized and sparse.

cues.zh: 页大小是 128，所以 MIP 0 是 128×128 个页。
cues.en: Page size is 128, so MIP 0 is 128 by 128 pages.

cues.zh: 每帧的虚拟内存分配相当直接。
cues.en: Allocation of the virtual memory every frame is fairly straightforward.

cues.zh: 对于屏幕上的每个像素，对所有影响该像素的光源，将位置投影到阴影贴图空间。
cues.en: For each pixel on screen, for all of the lights affecting this pixel, project the position into shadow map space.

cues.zh: 选择一个 MIP 级别，使一个纹素对应一个屏幕像素的大小，并按需将该级别中的该页标记为需要。
cues.en: Pick the MIP level where one texel matches the size of one screen pixel, mark that page in that level as needed.

cues.zh: 我们也支持缓存，因此会避免在阴影贴图中绘制上一帧已经覆盖过的区域。
cues.en: We support caching too, so we avoid drawing anywhere in the shadow map that we that we've already covered in a previous frame.

cues.zh: 这意味着大多数情况下，每帧更新的阴影贴图区域仅限于物体移动的区域，或相机移动时的视锥体边缘。
cues.en: This means for the most part on the only regions of the shadow maps that are updated each frame are those where objects are moving or edges of the frustum as the camera moves.

cues.zh: 尽管我们支持所有网格渲染到虚拟阴影贴图中，但与 Nanite 结合时才是它真正出彩的地方。
cues.en: Although we support all meshes rendering into virtual shadow maps, combined with Nanite is really where it shines.

cues.zh: 但首先，我们需要对 Nanite 渲染做一些修改，让它更高效。
cues.en: But first we need to make some modifications to Nanite rendering to make it efficient.

cues.zh: Nanite 管线其实相当深，同步开销很大。
cues.en: The Nanite pipeline is actually fairly deep with significant synchronization overhead.

cues.zh: 与全分辨率主视图的开销相比，这点开销微不足道。
cues.en: That's tiny, compared to the proportional to the cost of a full resolution primary view.

cues.zh: 但为了少量工作就启动整条管线，效率会非常低。
cues.en: But spinning up the pipeline for a minor amount of work can be very inefficient.

cues.zh: 所以我们不想多次调用 Nanite 渲染，比如每盏灯调用一次，更糟的是每盏灯每个阴影贴图的每个 MIP 级别都调用一次。
cues.en: So we don't want to call Nanite render many times, like once for each light or worse, for each MIP level for each shadow map for each light.

cues.zh: 于是我们给 Nanite 加了多视图支持。
cues.en: Instead we added multi-view support to Nanite.

cues.zh: Nanite 管线接收一个要渲染的视图数组，而不只是一个视图。
cues.en: The Nanite pipeline gets an array of views to render instead of just one.

cues.zh: 现在，Nanite 不仅能通过单条依赖的间接调度链绘制整个场景，还能一次把场景中每盏灯的所有阴影贴图渲染到它们所有虚拟化的 MIP 贴图上。
cues.en: Now, not only can Nanite draw the entire scene with a single chain of dependent dispatch indirects, it can render all shadow maps for every light in the scene to all of their virtualized MIP maps at once.

cues.zh: 在极端情况下，相比逐个单独调用，我们观察到 100 倍加速。
cues.en: In extreme cases, we've seen 100x speed up compared to individual calls.

cues.zh: 为了剔除会绘制到阴影贴图未映射区域的工作，我们在通常用 HCB 测试包围矩形的位置旁，插入一个额外测试。
cues.en: To call work that would draw to unmapped regions of the shadow map, we slot in an extra test next to where we normally test the bounding wrecht against the HCB.

cues.zh: 对于阴影，它还会针对所需页掩码进行测试。
cues.en: For shadows, it also tests against the needed pages mask.

cues.zh: 如果一个实例或簇与所需页面没有重叠，就会被剔除。
cues.en: If an instance or cluster doesn't overlap a needed page, it is culled.

cues.zh: 我们写入的物理纹理在虚拟空间中并不连续。
cues.en: The physical texture we are writing to isn't contiguous in virtual space.

cues.zh: 这意味着，与多个页面重叠的簇不能指望像素寻址是直接的。
cues.en: This means clusters that overlap multiple pages can't expect the addressing of the pixel to be direct.

cues.zh: 我们有多种方法来处理这一点。
cues.en: We have multiple approaches to handle that.

cues.zh: 对于软件光栅化器，最好让内层循环尽可能简单。
cues.en: For the software rasterizer, it is best to keep the inner loop as simple as possible.

cues.zh: 我们发现，即使内层循环中只多一次移位，也会带来可测量的开销。
cues.en: We found even a single additional shift in the inner loop is measurable.

cues.zh: 因此，每个重叠页面只向光栅化器发出一个可见簇，对该簇只做一次页表转换，并裁剪到该页面的像素。
cues.en: So instead we emit one visible cluster to the rasterizer per overlapped page, do the page translation once for the cluster, and scissor to the page pixels.

cues.zh: 软件簇很小，所以大多数只重叠单个页面。
cues.en: Software clusters are small, so most overlap a single page.

cues.zh: 硬件簇更大。
cues.en: Hardware clusters are bigger.

cues.zh: 通常会重叠多个页面，复制顶点和三角形的开销并不合理。
cues.en: Often overlap multiple pages and duplicating the vertex and triangle cost doesn't make sense.

cues.zh: 相反，我们逐像素执行虚拟地址到物理地址的页表转换。
cues.en: Instead, we do the virtual to physical page table translation per pixel.

cues.zh: 因为我们进行的是原子 UAV 写入，即使走硬件路径，也可以自由地分散写入。
cues.en: Because we are doing atomic UAV writes, even in the hardware path, we are free to scatter them.

cues.zh: Nanite 的细粒度调用对高效虚拟阴影贴图帮助极大，细节层级也同样有帮助。
cues.en: Nanite's fine-grained calling is hugely helpful for efficient virtual shadow maps, but so is the level of detail.

cues.zh: 就像主视图一样，Nanite 选择匹配一个像素误差的 LOD。
cues.en: Just like in the primary view, Nanite picks the LOD matching one pixel error.

cues.zh: 对于阴影，这意味着它正在光栅化到的 mip 层级的像素。
cues.en: In the case of shadows, this means the pixels of the mip level it is rasterizing to.

cues.zh: 还要记住，mip 层级的选择要让一个纹素对应一个像素。
cues.en: And remember that the mip level was chosen such that one texel equals one pixel.

cues.zh: 这保持了开销大致随屏幕分辨率而非场景复杂度缩放这一特性。
cues.en: This maintains the property of roughly scaling cost with screen resolution, not scene complexity.

cues.zh: 这并不意味着绘制到阴影贴图的三角形与主视图中绘制的三角形完全相同。
cues.en: That does not mean that the triangles drawn to the shadow map are exactly the same as those drawn in the primary view.

cues.zh: 这种不匹配会导致错误的自阴影，我们用一小段屏幕空间追踪来弥补这一差异，覆盖两者可能不同的区域。
cues.en: That mismatch can cause incorrect self-shadowing and we address that discrepancy with a short screen-space trace to span the zone where they can differ.

cues.zh: 几何体的虚拟内存类比在概念上与虚拟纹理非常相似。
cues.en: The virtual memory analogy for geometry is conceptually very similar to virtual texturing.

cues.zh: 尽管细节不同，也存在一些独特的挑战。
cues.en: Although the details are different and there's some unique challenges.

cues.zh: 相似之处在于，GPU 在发现质量不足的地方请求数据，CPU 则通过从磁盘加载数据来异步满足这些请求。
cues.en: It is similar in that GPU requests data where it finds the quality is insufficient and the CPU asynchro- asynchronously fulfills those requests by loading the data from disk.

cues.zh: 不同之处在于，我们加载和卸载数据时必须确保它始终是整个 DAG 的一个有效切割。
cues.en: It is different in that we load and unload data we need to make sure that it is always a valid cut of the full DAG.

cues.zh: 那么我们流式加载什么呢？
cues.en: So what do we stream?

cues.zh: 最小的可流式加载单元是什么？
cues.en: What is the smallest streamable unit?

cues.zh: 记住，简化是在组级别发生的。
cues.en: Remember how simplification happens at the group level.

cues.zh: 按照构造方式，一个簇组正好由其父级替换。
cues.en: By construction, a cluster group is exactly replaced by its parents.

cues.zh: 反过来，父级只能由完整的一组子节点替换。
cues.en: Conversely, the parents can only be replaced by a full group of children.

cues.zh: 因此，在该组中它的所有同级簇也加载完成之前，我们不能开始渲染某个簇，否则就无法构成完整替换。
cues.en: So we can't start rendering a cluster before all of its siblings in that group are also loaded, otherwise it won't be a complete replacement.

cues.zh: 所以，没有理由以比组更细的粒度进行流式加载。
cues.en: Thus there's no reason to stream at a finer than group granularity.

cues.zh: 这样做甚至可能导致渲染错误。
cues.en: Doing so could even result in incorrect rendering.

cues.zh: 与虚拟纹理相比的另一个不同点是，几何体的大小是可变的，甚至在压缩之前也是如此。
cues.en: Another difference compared to virtual texturing is that geometry has variable size, even before compression.

cues.zh: 簇的顶点数、属性数等都不固定。
cues.en: Clusters have a variable number of vertices, attributes, and so on.

cues.zh: 为避免内存碎片，我们希望使用固定大小的页，但这也意味着每页必须容纳数量可变的几何数据。
cues.en: To avoid memory fragmentation, we want to use fixed-size pages, but this also means we have to fit a variable amount of geometry per page.

cues.zh: 因此，我们用簇组填充固定大小的页。
cues.en: So we fill fixed-size pages with cluster groups.

cues.zh: 在决定哪些组放入同一页时，我们会同时考虑空间局部性和 DAG 中的层级。
cues.en: We account for both spatial locality and level in the DAG when deciding which groups to put on the same page.

cues.zh: 这样做是为了尽量减少运行时可能需要的页数。
cues.en: We do this to try to minimize the number of pages that are likely to be needed at runtime.

cues.zh: 第一页是根页，始终常驻，并在能塞进一页的范围内包含 DAG 顶部尽可能多的内容。
cues.en: The first page, the root page, is always resident and contains as much of the top of the DAG as we can fit in a page.

cues.zh: 始终保留根页意味着无论发生什么，我们总有东西可渲染。
cues.en: Always having the root page means we always have something to render, no matter what.

cues.zh: 常驻页存储在 GPU 上的一个大的字节地址缓冲区中。
cues.en: The resident pages are stored in one big byte address buffer on the GPU.

cues.zh: 不幸的是，用整组来填充页会造成大量冗余空间，因为组可能相当大。
cues.en: Unfortunately, filling pages with whole groups can result in a lot of slack, because groups can be quite large.

cues.zh: 一个组包含 8 到 32 个簇，每个簇最大约 2 KB。
cues.en: They range from 8 to 32 clusters and each cluster is up to about 2 kilobytes.

cues.zh: 我们的解决方案在概念上很简单。
cues.en: Our solution is conceptually simple.

cues.zh: 我们以簇为粒度把组拆成多个部分。
cues.en: We split the groups into multiple parts at cluster granularity.

cues.zh: 如前所述，一个簇只有在所有同级簇都加载完成后才能绘制，因此拆分后的组只有在所有部分都加载完成后才被视为活跃。
cues.en: Because previously mentioned a cluster cannot be drawn before all of its siblings are loaded, a split group is only considered active when all of its parts are loaded.

cues.zh: 通过按簇粒度而不是按组填充页，我们在页中只产生约 1% 的浪费。
cues.en: By filling pages at cluster granularity instead of groups, we only incur around 1% waste in the pages.

cues.zh: 那么，我们如何决定加载什么？
cues.en: So how do we decide what to load?

cues.zh: 对于虚拟纹理，这很简单。
cues.en: For virtual texturing, this is easy.

cues.zh: 需要加载的数据可以直接根据 UV 坐标以及选定的 LOD 级别或 UV 梯度来确定。
cues.en: The data that needs to be loaded can be determined directly from the UV coordinates and the selected LOD level or UV gradient.

cues.zh: 对 Nanite 来说，我们无法只根据查询位置和 LOD 误差直接找到数据。
cues.en: For Nanite, we can't find the data directly from the query position and LOD error.

cues.zh: 我们需要遍历层级结构来找到它。
cues.en: We need to traverse the hierarchy to find it.

cues.zh: 遍历过程中，我们必须查看当前流送裁剪范围之外的节点，并判断如果它们已经驻留，是否本应被绘制。
cues.en: During traversal, we have to look at nodes beyond the current streaming cut and determine if they would have been drawn had they been resident.

cues.zh: 这意味着，被调用的层级结构需要覆盖当前已流送内容之外的部分。
cues.en: This means that the calling hierarchy needs to cover more than what is currently streamed in.

cues.zh: 层级结构很小，因为它只包含有关簇组频率的元信息。
cues.en: The hierarchy is small as it only contains meta-information about cluster group frequency.

cues.zh: 所以为简单起见，我们始终让层级结构完全驻留。
cues.en: So for simplicity, we always keep the hierarchy fully resident.

cues.zh: 这还有一个好处：遍历独立于当前流送裁剪，并且可以越过它深入几层。
cues.en: This has the added benefit that traversal is independent from the current streaming cut and can go several levels beyond it.

cues.zh: 一个新对象可以立即从目标质量所需的所有层级请求数据。
cues.en: A new object can immediately request data from all of the levels it needs for target quality.

cues.zh: 如果层级结构本身也要流式加载，那就必须逐层进行，并跨多帧完成。
cues.en: Had the hierarchy itself also then streamed, this would have to happen level by level over several frames.

cues.zh: I/O 延迟会乘以我们落后的层级数，从而导致更明显的 pop-in。
cues.en: I/O latency would be multiplied by the number of levels we are off, which translates to more visible pop-in.

cues.zh: 在实践中，流式加载请求是作为分层簇剔除遍历的一部分生成的。
cues.en: In in practice, the streaming requests are generated as part of the hierarchical cluster calling traversal.

cues.zh: 一个请求由一组页面组成，其优先级基于 LOD 误差。
cues.en: A request consists of a range of pages with a priority based on the LOD error.

cues.zh: 这些请求不仅为主视图生成，也会为任何活动的阴影视图生成，不过后者的优先级更低。
cues.en: They are generated not only for the primary view, but also any active shadow views, although those are considered lower priority.

cues.zh: 还值得注意的是，即使页面已经驻留，也会发出请求来更新其优先级。
cues.en: It is also worth noting that the requests are emitted even for resident pages to update their priorities.

cues.zh: CPU 会异步回读这些请求。
cues.en: The requests are read back asynchronously by the CPU.

cues.zh: 它会补上缺失的 DAG 依赖，并为最高优先级的页面发出 I/O 请求。
cues.en: It adds any missing DAG dependencies and issues I/O requests for the highest priority pages.

cues.zh: 最后，当 I/O 请求就绪时，页数据会被装入 GPU，并更新 GPU 侧的数据结构。
cues.en: Finally, when the I/O requests are ready, the page data is installed on the GPU, and the GPU-side data structures are updated.

cues.zh: 这包括修正已加载或已卸载页的指针，修正已完成或不再完整的拆分组的指针，还涉及将簇标记为叶子或取消叶子标记。
cues.en: This includes fixing up pointers for loaded or unloaded pages, fixing pointers for split groups that have been completed or are no longer complete, and involves marking and unmarking clusters as leaves.

cues.zh: 我要讲的最后一个主题是压缩。
cues.en: The last topic I'll talk about is compression.

cues.zh: 对于 Nanite，我们实际上有两种压缩几何格式。
cues.en: For Nanite, we actually have two compressed geometry formats.

cues.zh: 它们表示相同的数据，但针对不同目标做了优化。
cues.en: They represent the same data, but are optimized for different goals.

cues.zh: 内存表示是渲染代码在光栅化以及延迟材质通道中直接使用的形式。
cues.en: The memory representation is what is used directly by the rendering code during rasterization and for the deferred material passes.

cues.zh: 它需要近乎即时地解码，并支持随机访问，因为任意三角形都可能通过可见性缓冲区查找来请求。
cues.en: This needs to be near instant to decode and random access as any triangle can be requested from a visibility buffer lookup.

cues.zh: 这里的目标是压低流送池所需的内存。
cues.en: The goal here is to keep the memory required for the streaming pool down.

cues.zh: 即使内存多得可以挥霍，把更多数据放进缓存也意味着更少的缓存未命中，也就减少 IO 和模型突然弹出的几率。
cues.en: Even if we had the memory to burn, fitting more data in the cache means less cache misses, which means less IO and chance for pop-in.

cues.zh: 不过有个很小的问题。
cues.en: There's a really small though.

cues.zh: 我们大可以在实例变得很小时直接剔除它们。
cues.en: We could just call instances when they get tiny.

cues.zh: 但如果它们是结构性的建筑构件，就不行。
cues.en: Except not if they're structural building blocks.

cues.zh: 比如从很远处看一栋建筑的一段墙体，剔除小实例可能让整栋建筑消失。
cues.en: Say a wall section of a building seen from very far away, calling small instances could mean entire buildings vanish.

cues.zh: 这种情况有多常见？
cues.en: How often does this happen?

cues.zh: 真的值得处理吗？
cues.en: Is it even worth addressing?

cues.zh: 自从用上 Nanite，我们的美术把实例数量推得和多边形数量一样高，甚至更高。
cues.en: Since getting their hands on Nanite, our artists have pushed instance count just as much, if not more so than poly count.

cues.zh: 办公室里的笑话是：实例就是新的三角形。
cues.en: Joke around the office is instances are the new triangles.

cues.zh: 这给我们计划改进的许多方面带来了压力，但微小实例绝对是个问题。
cues.en: This stresses numerous things we plan to improve, but tiny instances were absolutely a problem.

cues.zh: 我们最终需要合并。
cues.en: We will need to merge eventually.

cues.zh: 显然，远处区域在某个阶段需要流式切换到更廉价的代理。
cues.en: Obviously, distant lands need to stream out to a cheaper proxy at some point.

cues.zh: 即使我们能让实例的渲染开销完美扩展，存储它们的内存也无法做到。
cues.en: Even if we could make the rendering cost for instances scale perfectly, the memory to store them won't.

cues.zh: 光是变换本身，到某个阶段就会变得过多。
cues.en: Just the transforms themselves will become too much at some point.

cues.zh: 我们希望未来支持分层实例化来改变这个局面，但它并不适用于所有情况。
cues.en: We hope to support hierarchical instancing in the future to change this equation, but it doesn't apply to all cases.

cues.zh: 远处需要通用合并，但这意味着唯一数据。
cues.en: We need general-purpose merging in the distance, but that means unique data.

cues.zh: 而高分辨率的唯一数据会很快失控。
cues.en: And high resolution unique data gets out of control really fast.

cues.zh: 我们不希望世界规模受限于巨型纹理或巨型几何体这类东西。
cues.en: We don't want mega texture or mega geometry sort of limitations on world scale.

cues.zh: 理想情况下，几何体像素级精确，远处也没有感知损失。
cues.en: Ideally geometry is pixel perfect with no perceptual loss at distance.

cues.zh: 所以合并代理需要尽可能推远，而我们必须在那之前找到解决方案。
cues.en: So merge proxies need to be pushed as far away as possible and we need a solution before that.

cues.zh: 我们目前的解决方案是可见性缓冲区 imposter。
cues.en: Our current solution to that is visibility buffer imposters.

cues.zh: 这就是基础的静态 imposter，带了一个小改动。
cues.en: This is your basic static imposters with a small tweak.

cues.zh: 也就是不存储颜色或 G-buffer 属性。
cues.en: That you don't store color or G buffer attributes.

cues.zh: 它们存储来自根簇的深度和三角形 ID。
cues.en: They store depth and triangle ID from the root cluster.

cues.zh: 这可以直接注入屏幕的可见性缓冲区，并支持材质重映射、非均匀缩放以及 Nanite 支持的其他所有内容。
cues.en: That can be directly injected into the screen's visibility buffer and supports remapping materials, non-uniform scale and anything else Nanite supports.

cues.zh: 在某些情况下确实能注意到质量损失，这意味着切换到它时有时会被察觉为一次跳变。
cues.en: There's definitely a quality loss that can be noticed in some cases, meaning switching to it can sometimes be noticed as a pop.

cues.zh: 通常这只会在许多相同的网格彼此相邻时发生，比如重复的墙体段；切换之所以明显，是因为发生了批量变化，而且旁边就有可直接比较的对象。
cues.en: Usually this only happens when many of the same mesh are next to one another like repeating wall sections and the switch is noticeable because there is a bulk change and a directly neighboring thing to compare it to.

cues.zh: 不过大多数时候，它运行得相当不错。
cues.en: Most of the time it works pretty well though.

cues.zh: 我很想把它替换成同样快、但占用内存更少且真正无缝的方案。
cues.en: I would love to replace this with something that is just as fast, but consumes less memory and is truly seamless.

cues.zh: 接下来讲材质。
cues.en: Let's move on to materials.

cues.zh: 这和之前讲过的内容相同，只是针对 Nanite 展开更多细节。
cues.en: This is the same thing we covered before, but with more detail relative to Nanite.

cues.zh: 解码可见性缓冲区后，我们基本上就拥有了像素着色器通常执行所需的一切。
cues.en: After decoding the visibility buffer, we basically have everything a pixel shader normally has to execute.

cues.zh: 因此我们可以绘制一个覆盖屏幕的四边形，解码可见性缓冲区，并执行材质像素着色器，几乎就像它在光栅化期间被绑定一样。
cues.en: So we could draw a quad covering the screen, decode the vis buffer and evaluate the material pixel shader almost like it was bound during rasterization.

cues.zh: 在 Nanite 中，顶点变换可能是固定功能，但我们希望支持美术师创建的完整像素着色器。
cues.en: Vertex transform might be fixed function in Nanite, but we want to support full artist-created pixel shaders.

cues.zh: 所以我们不希望所有像素只用一个材质。
cues.en: So we don't want just one material for all pixels.

cues.zh: 我们怎么知道这个像素使用什么材质？
cues.en: How do we know what material this pixel has?

cues.zh: 我们也可以从 vis buffer 推导出这一点。
cues.en: We can derive that from the vis buffer too.

cues.zh: 理论上，用可调用着色器，我们可以这样在一个 pass 中应用所有材质，但这会带来复杂性和低效问题。
cues.en: With callable shaders we could in theory apply all materials in a single pass this way, but there are complexities and inefficiencies there.

cues.zh: 相反，我们可以为每个唯一材质绘制一个全屏四边形，并跳过材质 ID 不匹配的像素。
cues.en: Instead, we could draw a full screen quad per unique material and skip the material the pixels not matching this material ID.

cues.zh: 不幸的是，由于所有调用都由 GPU 驱动，CPU 并不知道哪些材质可见。
cues.en: Unfortunately, because all calling is GPU driven, the CPU isn't aware of what materials are visible.
